eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Summer
eden.uk.plus1.description: It is high summer in the polar regions, and the sun never sets. Vast hordes of summer visitors cram a lifetime of drama into one long, magical day; they must feed, fight and rear their young in this brief window of plenty. Summer is a tough time for the polar bear family, as their ice world melts away and the cubs take their first swimming lesson. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Autumn
eden.uk.plus1.description: Polar landscapes in autumn are transformed as the big freeze returns. Most animals leave on epic journeys, some now battle to breed, and for the hardy few it's a time of opportunity. In the Arctic, polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast to wait for the return of the ice. Tempers soon fray and violent contests break out. Off the coast 2,000 beluga whales head for a special estuary, a gigantic `whale spa'. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Winter
eden.uk.plus1.description: Winter is the greatest test for life in the polar regions, as temperatures plummet to 70 below and winds reach 200kph. Only a few remarkable survivors gamble on remaining in these extreme conditions. In the Arctic, a female polar bear treks into the mountains to give birth. Out on the frozen ocean, the entire population of the world's spectacled eider ducks braves the winter in a giant ice hole. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - The Last Frontier
eden.uk.plus1.description: Revealing the extraordinary riches and wonders of the polar regions that have kept people visiting them for thousands of years. Today, their survival relies on a combination of ancient wisdom and cutting-edge science. Most Arctic people live in Siberia, either in cities like Norilsk - the coldest city on earth - or out on the tundra, where tribes like the Dogan survive by herding reindeer. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

Jill Douglas presents coverage of both teams' second match of the Northern Hemisphere Series, and penultimate contest of the round-robin stage as a whole, held at Stade de France. The Springboks have won nine of the last 10 meetings between the sides, with five of those triumphs coming here, including a 32-17 victory with 14 men when the nations last faced each other 12 months ago. He rounds off his trip by cooking at an award-winning vineyard.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E20 New York The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : Italy v Argentina
itv1anglia.uk.description: Italy v Argentina (Kick-off 11.40am). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Stadio Comunale Luigi Ferraris in Genoa. Argentina have won the last nine meetings between the sides, with the most recent of those victories an emphatic 50-18 victory in Udine two years ago. With commentary by Nick Heath and Nolli Waterman, and analysis from Jamie Roberts and Sam Warburton.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : Wales v New Zealand
itv1anglia.uk.description: Wales v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Principality Stadium in Cardiff. Wales have not defeated the All Blacks since 1953, with New Zealand winning 34 consecutive matches against them since then. The last meeting between the sides came here 12 months ago, when the visitors scored seven tries in a 52-26 triumph. Commentary comes from Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams, and Jamie Roberts, with analysis by Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton, and Dan Biggar.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : England v Japan
itv1anglia.uk.description: England v Japan (Kick-off 4.40pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Allianz Stadium Twickenham. England have won all six of the previous meetings between the nations, including a comfortable 59-14 victory here when the sides last faced each other two years ago, and they will expect to maintain that 100 per cent record today. With commentary by Nick Mullins and David Flatman, analysis from Ugo Monye and Maggie Alphonsi, and reports by Topsy Ojo.

Ireland boast a 100 per cent record from their eight meetings with Fiji, and comfortably prevailed 52-17 in the most recent of those encounters two years ago, which also took place at this venue. With the Fijians failing to win any of their opening three contests, the Irish will be expecting yet another victory this evening. With commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy, analysis from Ugo Monye and Maggie Alphonsi, and reports by Claire Thomas.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure

itvwales.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh

Plus, a celebration of the role of donkeys during the world wars, and the D-Day Darlings perform a Vera Lynn classic. Then, original emergency service vehicles used to help wounded soldiers during the war years make their way onto the show. (Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2026

itvwales.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Italy v Argentina
itvwales.uk.description: Live rugby from Round Five of the Nations Championship, as Italy host Argentina at the Stadio Luigi Ferraris in Genoa. Presented by Lauren Salter, with guests Jamie Roberts and Sam Warburton. Commentary comes from Nick Heath and Nolli Waterman. Every point counts as both sides look towards Finals Weekend at the Allianz Stadium in Twickenham at the end of the month. (Rugby)

itvwales.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Wales v New Zealand
itvwales.uk.description: Live rugby from Round Five of the Nations Championship, as Wales host New Zealand at the Principality in Cardiff. Presented by Lauren Salter, with guests Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton and Dan Biggar. Commentary comes from Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams and Jamie Roberts. Every point counts as both sides look towards Finals Weekend at the Allianz Stadium in Twickenham at the end of the month. (Rugby)

itvwales.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: England v Japan
itvwales.uk.description: Eddie Jones returns to the Allianz Stadium as his Japan side take on England in the Nations Championship. Jones guided England to a World Cup final and three Six Nations titles during his seven year spell in charge, but will now pit his wits against Steve Borthwick who was part of his coaching set up during this time. Borthwick's England team are still a work in progress - but will be aiming for a repeat performance of their last outing against Japan in November 2024. (Rugby)

itvwales.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Ireland v Fiji
itvwales.uk.description: Ireland continue their autumn campaign in the Nations Championship with a date against Fiji at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin. Andy Farrell's side picked up wins against Australia and Japan in the summer fixtures in the tournament and will be targeting another victory against a Fijian Side who have just appointed the South African Jake White as their new coach. Mark Pougatch is joined by Ugo Monye and Maggie Alphonsi for live coverage, with pitchside reports from Claire Thomas. (Rugby)

talkingpictures.uk.description: Swiftnick frees Aphrina, a gypsy girl from a forester's trap. In order to prove to her tribe he has not shamed the girl, Swiftnick must face three ordeals chosen by fate. (Action, Adventure, Biography, Entertainment) - 1982

talkingpictures.uk.title: Maigret - Raise Your Right Hand
talkingpictures.uk.description: Due to give evidence at a murder trial, Maigret is unable to shake his conviction that the accused is actually innocent. (Crime drama) - 1961

talkingpictures.uk.title: Lillie - The New Helen
talkingpictures.uk.description: Lillie continues to captivate London society, having at one point to refuse the affections of an amorous King Leopold of Belgium. Her friend Oscar Wilde composes a poem for her called The New Helen, and cannot understand how she can remain in such a loveless marriage to Edward. But Lillie's fortunes are to change when she invites the Prince of Wales to dinner. (Drama, History) - 1978

talkingpictures.uk.title: Bellman and True (1987)
talkingpictures.uk.description: After losing his job and wife, computer engineer Hiller barely has time to pity himself before he's abducted by thugs looking to collect a debt for Salto. Salto has also had Hiller's teenage stepson kidnapped to ensure his complete cooperation. (Crime drama) - 1987

talkingpictures.uk.title: Eurotrash
talkingpictures.uk.description: Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. Tonight, we solve the secret of the moving nipple, look into the mystery of wee willy winky, watch as Lolo makes a ham sandwich and see a man getting nibbled.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Yanky Panky - Episode 1
talkingpictures.uk.description: Join country music persona Tina C as she uncovers the eccentric subcultures, bizarre personalities, and the rude, crude and lewd underbelly of American society. (Comedy) - 2000

talkingpictures.uk.title: Runaway Train (1985)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Philosophical action thriller about two escaped prisoners who hide on board a train speeding through Alaska. The driver suffers a fatal heart attack and the train races out of control through the icy wilderness. With the railroad signalmen unable to stop it and a vindictive prison warden desperately pursuing them by helicopter, the train's passengers look set to face disaster. Based on a screenplay by Akira Kurosawa. (Action) - 1985

talkingpictures.uk.title: A Saint, A Woman, A Devil
talkingpictures.uk.description: Sylvia is a seemingly quiet and saintly person. But she is hiding a promiscuous multiple personality disorder.

talkingpictures.uk.title: To The Four Corners
talkingpictures.uk.description: From Kilkeel in Northern Ireland to Lincoln Cathedral, travel across the four corners of the United Kingdom in 1956.

talkingpictures.uk.title: One Step Beyond - The Forests of the Night

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Atomic Submarine (1959)

amc.us.title: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
amc.us.description: Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) battles horrible Jabba the Hutt and cruel Darth Vader to save his comrades in the Rebel Alliance and triumph over the Galactic Empire. Han Solo (Harrison Ford) and Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) reaffirm their love and team with Chewbacca, Lando Calrissian (Billy Dee Williams), the Ewoks and the androids C-3PO and R2-D2 to aid in the disruption of the Dark Side and the defeat of the evil emperor. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1983

amc.us.title: Star Wars: A New Hope
amc.us.description: The Imperial Forces -- under orders from cruel Darth Vader (David Prowse) -- hold Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) hostage, in their efforts to quell the rebellion against the Galactic Empire. Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) and Han Solo (Harrison Ford), captain of the Millennium Falcon, work together with the companionable droid duo R2-D2 (Kenny Baker) and C-3PO (Anthony Daniels) to rescue the beautiful princess, help the Rebel Alliance, and restore freedom and justice to the Galaxy. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1977

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

cinemax.us.title: Shut In
cinemax.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside. (Thriller) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemax.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Country, Rock) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Wonka
cinemax.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time. (Family, Musical comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemax.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Won't Back Down
cinemax.us.description: Jamie Fitzpatrick and Nona Alberts are two women from opposite sides of the social and economic track, but they have one thing in common: a mission to fix their community's broken school and ensure a bright future for their children. The two women refuse to let any obstacles stand in their way as they battle a bureaucracy that's hopelessly mired in traditional thinking, and they seek to re-energize a faculty that has lost its passion for teaching. (Drama) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: The Sessions
cinemax.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity. (Comedy drama, Biography) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemax.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Mystery) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemax.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Thriller, Romance, Science fiction, Crime drama) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Us
cinemax.us.description: A couple and their two children must fight for survival when four masked strangers descend upon their beachfront home. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. - 2019

cinemax.us.title: The Nun
cinemax.us.description: Vatican officials send a priest and a novitiate to investigate the suicide of a young nun in Romania. They soon find themselves in a fight for their lives when they encounter a demonic force that takes the shape of a nun. - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Nun II
cinemax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. - 2023

cinemax.us.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
cinemax.us.description: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves. - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Enemy
cinemax.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Solace
cinemax.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer. - 2015

cinemax.us.title: The Rover
cinemax.us.description: After thieves steal his car, a hardened loner (Guy Pearce) forces a wounded member (Robert Pattinson) of their gang to help him track them down across a scorched and perilous landscape. - 2014

cinemax.us.title: Aniara
cinemax.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemax.us.description: Harley Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask and every other thug in Gotham. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. - 2020

cinemax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: A scientist's quest to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease unintentionally results in a highly intelligent chimpanzee, which may signal the end of man's dominion over Earth. - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Human survivors of a plague threaten Caesar's growing nation of genetically evolved apes. Though they reach a fragile peace, soon both sides are brought to the brink of a war that will determine which will become Earth's dominant species. - 2014

cinemax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemax.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Western, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Whistlers
cinemax.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. (Comedy drama, Thriller) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
cinemax.us.description: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait. (Historical drama, LGBTQ, Drama) - 2019

cinemaxaction.us.title: Parental Guidance
cinemaxaction.us.description: Minor-league baseball announcer Artie Decker (Billy Crystal) and his wife, Diane (Bette Midler), get to see their only child, Alice (Marisa Tomei), very seldom. To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end. (Children, Comedy, Movie) - 2012-12-25

cinemaxaction.us.title: The East
cinemaxaction.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Adventure, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2013-05-31

cinemaxaction.us.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
cinemaxaction.us.description: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Animation, Comedy) - 2021-08-10

cinemaxaction.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast. (Movie, Science fiction) - 1956-04-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla, King of the Monsters!
cinemaxaction.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast. (Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1956-04-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla Raids Again
cinemaxaction.us.description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan. (Action, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1955-04-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemaxaction.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Crime, Dark comedy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 1971-02-02

cinemaxaction.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemaxaction.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Documentary, Drama, Movie, Western) - 2024-05-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Alto Knights
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the 1950s, notorious New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the city streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie) - 2025-03-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: Aniara
cinemaxaction.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Drama, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2018-09-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemaxaction.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2017-05-26

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Predator
cinemaxaction.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and a disgruntled science teacher can prevent the end of the human race. (Action, Adventure, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2018-09-06

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2024-03-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
cinemaxaction.us.description: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run and do the harder job of staying put. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2019-03-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Hangover Part II
cinemaxaction.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, prewedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy, Movie) - 2011-05-26

cinemaxaction.us.title: Super Troopers 2
cinemaxaction.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy, Crime, Movie, Mystery) - 2018-04-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Return of Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: Okumura witnesses a huge monster during a storm. Biologist Hayashida hears Okumura's story from Toto Nippo reporter Maki and concludes that Godzilla, who was buried 30 years ago, has come back to life. Godzilla then appears in Tokyo Bay. (Action, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1984-12-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: Epic
cinemaxaction.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children) - 2013-05-22

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Flash
cinemaxaction.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2023-06-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Player
cinemaxaction.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1992-04-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Due Date
cinemaxaction.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Dark comedy, Drama, Movie) - 2010-11-05

cinemaxaction.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemaxaction.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxwest.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxwest.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

cinemaxwest.us.title: Shut In
cinemaxwest.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside. (Thriller) - 2016

cinemaxwest.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemaxwest.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Country, Rock) - 2005

cinemaxwest.us.title: Wonka
cinemaxwest.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time. (Family, Musical comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemaxwest.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: Won't Back Down
cinemaxwest.us.description: Jamie Fitzpatrick and Nona Alberts are two women from opposite sides of the social and economic track, but they have one thing in common: a mission to fix their community's broken school and ensure a bright future for their children. The two women refuse to let any obstacles stand in their way as they battle a bureaucracy that's hopelessly mired in traditional thinking, and they seek to re-energize a faculty that has lost its passion for teaching. (Drama) - 2012

cinemaxwest.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemaxwest.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Sessions
cinemaxwest.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity. (Comedy drama, Biography) - 2012

cinemaxwest.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemaxwest.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Mystery) - 2011

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau

cinemaxwest.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes

cinemaxwest.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxwest.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. cinemaxwest.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes

Mistaking her for a princess and hoping to break the spell, Naveen plants a kiss on poor Tiana, thereby turning her into a frog as well. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity. (Animated, Children, Musical comedy, Adventure) - 2016

Stitch would be the perfect pet if he weren't in reality a genetic experiment who has escaped from an alien planet and crash-landed on Earth. Through her love, faith and unwavering belief in ohana, the Hawaiian concept of family, Lilo helps unlock Stitch's heart and gives him the ability to care for someone else. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2002

freeform.us.title: The Jungle Book

golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick shares solutions to combat the most common contact and trajectory problems suffered by less accomplished players. McCormick offers a series of drills and practice techniques that promote solid ball striking.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - RX - Sand Survival Tips
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick seeks to end all fear that players encounter when faced with a bunker shot. McCormick offers his fundamental concepts to thrive in the sand by demonstrating techniques related to setup, clubhead entry, trajectory, and spin control.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - RX - Fix Your Yips
golfpass.us.description: According to Cameron McCormick, players of every ability can suffer from the greenside yips, luckily McCormick offers a prescription to remedy the most prevalent symptom of the yips: lost confidence.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - RX - Greenside Practice and Games
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick explains why the best players in the world spend a large portion of their practice time around the green. McCormick demonstrates four practice session games designed to emphasize fundamentals.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - RX - Practice Putting
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick provides a prescription to create more structure during putting practice sessions. McCormick shares four practice games, which are designed to hone aim and accuracy, develop better speed control and avoid three putts.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - RX - Practice Wedges
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick uses a series of skill-based games to demonstrate how becoming more adept at distance control and trajectory can create consistency in performance.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Worst Swing Faults

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 6: Slice Stoppers

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 7: Putting Pointers

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 8: Majors Unclassified
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal share ball striking secrets from Masters Champions and Chevron Championship winners. Learn tips for working the ball used by Jack Nicklaus, Tiger Woods, Dustin Johnson, and Hideki Matsuyama.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 9: The Scoring Zone
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach how to go low in the scoring zone. Learn to stick wedge shots with lessons on solid contact, swing path, trajectory control, and distance control. Martin also shares wedge play advice from Open Champion Shane Lowry.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 10: Total Driving
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach how to hit the driver longer and straighter. Learn tips used by Rory McIlroy, Ernie Els, John Daly and more of the game's best all-around drivers. Martin also reveals how to set up for success on the tee.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 11: Lone Star Lessons
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal reveal what to learn from the game's greatest Texans. Martin teaches a swing move of solid contact used by Byron Nelson, Ben Hogan, Lee Trevino, and Scottie Scheffler.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 12: Sharpen Your Irons
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal give a road map to hit solid iron shots. Learn how to achieve impact while also improving arm structure and swing path. LPGA winner Gaby Lopez joins Martin & Blair on the range to reveal her favorite iron play drills.

gritxtra.us.title: The Tin Star
gritxtra.us.description: Morgan Hickman is a tough gunslinger with a knack for keeping his cool in tense situations. When he wanders into a town where the local lawman has been killed, he finds callow but eager Ben Owens temporarily acting as sheriff. Soon Ben, who wants to keep his new position, is looking to Morgan for guidance. Though the bounty hunter has his own issues with law enforcement, he admires Ben's enthusiasm and decides to train him to be an effective sheriff. (Movie, Western) - 1957-10-23

gritxtra.us.title: Silverado
gritxtra.us.description: Rambling man Emmett (Scott Glenn) assembles a group of misfit cowboys (Kevin Costner), (Kevin Kline, Danny Glover). After helping a group of settlers track down a pack of thieves, Emmett and his men descend on the troubled town of Silverado to seek their fortunes. Soon after arriving, they discover that the town has fallen into the grasp of greedy rancher Ethan McKendrick (Ray Baker) and corrupt Sheriff Cobb (Brian Dennehy) with whom many of Emmett's men have unfinished business. (Action, Drama, Movie, Western) - 1985-07-10

gritxtra.us.title: Two Mules for Sister Sara
gritxtra.us.description: When gunslinger Hogan (Clint Eastwood) discovers a group of men attempting to rape a young nun, Sara (Shirley MacLaine), he shoots them dead and rescues the woman. The two escape to a nearby camp of Mexican revolutionaries, who have hired Hogan to help fight the invading French army. En route, Sara turns out to be surprisingly crude for a nun, drinking, smoking and using curse words. When she also proves to be handy with a gun, Hogan begins wondering if she is telling him the whole truth. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Western) - 1970

gritxtra.us.title: Joe Kidd
gritxtra.us.description: In New Mexico, one-time bounty hunter Joe Kidd owns a ranch where a nearby group of Mexican revolutionaries, led by Luis Chama, fights for their rightful land after the U.S. government denies their claims. In response, a greedy landowner gathers a posse to capture Chama and solicits Kidd's assistance. Kidd, who has no interest in the matter, changes his mind when he discovers Chama has stolen a horse and roughed up a worker from his ranch. (Drama, Movie, Western) - 1972-10-21

gritxtra.us.title: High Plains Drifter
gritxtra.us.description: In this Western, a drifter with no name wanders into a small town, where his gun-slinging abilities are in high demand. When the drifter rides into Lago, he is met with incredulity and disapproval by the townspeople. But once he shows his skills with a pistol, the locals realize he may be able to help them fend off a band of criminals who have been terrorizing the town. He agrees to help the townspeople, but does so with his own secret agenda. (Drama, Movie, Mystery, Western) - 1973-04-19

gsn.us.title: Cash Cab
gsn.us.description: In this offbeat game show, players picked up in the Cash Cab have to answer trivia questions with mounting cash values before they reach their destination in order to win. If a player answers incorrectly three times, he is kicked out of the cab without any money. Help options include a Mobile Shout-Out (phone call) and Street Shout-Out (asking a stranger on the street). Once the player reaches his destination, he can leave the cab with his winnings, if any, or risk them on a more difficult question. A correct final answer doubles his winnings; an incorrect answer means he leaves the cab with no money at all. Comic Ben Bailey takes the cab's wheel as host. (Game show, Reality, Show) - 2005-12-05

The clique known as the Blue Ribbons are the eerie embodiment of academic excellence and clean living. But, like the rest of the town, they're a little too perfect. When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes). (Horror, Mystery, Science fiction) - 1998

Worse, it requires that Nick violate his most important rule: Always work alone. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2001

mgmplus.us.title: Red Eye

Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Nomad? No Way!
motortrend.us.description: After two shops and many stops and starts, a 1955 Nomad is ready to go all the way; Dave and the crew attempt to get the vehicle's warped metal back into the shape, the bodywork just right, and the paint to pop. (Reality, Auto) - 2016-12-27

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Back to Basics
motortrend.us.description: Dave returns to his roots when he purchases a 1965 Volkswagen Bus to restore, reupholster and flip; the 1968 Boss Mustang arrives for some upgrades. (Reality, Auto) - 2016-12-06

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The F Five OHHHHHHH
motortrend.us.description: The guys scramble to get the Ford F-150's exhaust, car color and engine just right; Dave hopes the owner of the super car farm truck will like the color he selected for the interior. (Reality, Auto) - 2016-11-22

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - It's Like 1929 in Here
motortrend.us.description: Dave goes out on a limb and purchases a 1929 roadster to fix up and flip, but Kevin fears he's bought another lemon; Kris tackles an engine that won't cooperate and hopes a two-dollar fix can solve a million-dollar problem. (Reality, Auto) - 2016-11-29

motortrend.us.title: Motor Mythbusters - Poor Man's Turbo
motortrend.us.description: Tory, Bisi and Faye test a myth from a popular movie franchise that claims you can increase boost and win a Cuban mile drag race from a turbocharged engine with just a length of wire and soda can tab. (Auto)

motortrend.us.title: Motor Mythbusters - Underwater EV and Birds Prefer Red Cars
motortrend.us.description: The team investigates if birds prefer pooping on red cars more than on other colors; seeing if an EV can drive through water and still work. (Auto)

motortrend.us.title: Motor Mythbusters - Fishtail Trailer Sway and EV Drain Pain
motortrend.us.description: The team test the dangerous myth that trailer sway can be corrected by accelerating; they investigate what happens to the performance of an electric vehicle when the battery is depleted. (Auto)

motortrend.us.title: Motor Mythbusters - Bedrock Buggy and Rolling Back the Miles
motortrend.us.description: The team sets out to fulfill Tory's childhood dream of building a full-scale "Flintstones" car; they test if it's possible to overcome the friction and inertia of a two-ton, wood and stone vehicle using just the power of their feet. (Auto)

motortrend.us.title: Motor Mythbusters - Hot Rod Hybrid and Blown Brake Lines
motortrend.us.description: The team tests whether adding a turbo to a hybrid makes it more fuel efficient. (Auto)

motortrend.us.title: Motor Mythbusters - Caddy Detonation Deflection and Range Against the EV
motortrend.us.description: The team tests a classic mafia movie myth, seeing if a plate under the driver could withstand a car bomb. (Auto)

motortrend.us.title: Motor Mythbusters - Leak in the Radiator and Cars vs. UFOs
motortrend.us.description: The team tests the myth that urine can be used as radiator fluid by pouring pee in a truck's radiator and seeing if it can drive without overheating; they re-create the presence of a UFO to test if it affects automobiles just like in sci-fi movies. (Auto)

motortrend.us.title: Motor Mythbusters - Chop Top Van and Farts in the Fast Lane
motortrend.us.description: In true hot rod fashion, the team tests the myth that chopping the top of a vehicle will make it go faster; they see whether opening the window closest to the person who farted is the best way to remove the odor from the vehicle. (Auto)

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - SEMA Dreamin'
motortrend.us.description: The Monkeys raise the bar at Gas Monkey Garage with a mind-blowing super-build they plan to debut at SEMA. (Reality, Auto) - 2019-08-05

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Keeping It Shelby
motortrend.us.description: The Monkeys prepare Richard's beloved 1968 Mustang for the prestigious Shelby Mustang Meet; Richard buys a one-of-a-kind van once owned by a Mopar icon. (Reality, Auto) - 2019-08-26

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Scout's Honor
motortrend.us.description: Richard Rawlings and the Monkeys forge gear-head history, packing a 1979 Scout with a 707 horsepower Hellcrate engine and scoring a record-breaking payday; after the Feds bust its owner, Richard may pony up to reclaim his old Ferrari Dark Horse. (Reality, Auto) - 2019-07-15

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Beyond Reasonable Scout
motortrend.us.description: The Monkeys race to be the first ever to drop a Hellcat motor in their 1979 International Scout and fulfill hot-rodder Richard's quest to fetch a world record for the most expensive ever sold; Richard urges a friend to buy a 1963 Stingray. (Reality, Auto) - 2019-07-22

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Vintage Payday
motortrend.us.description: Richard races toward a vintage payday by restoring his '37 Buick Racer back to its Indy 500 roots; the guys buy a one-owner '77 Blazer that could fetch them double their money; a surprise birthday gift has Richard feeling nostalgic. (Reality, Auto) - 2020-04-26

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - No Second Chances
motortrend.us.description: The Monkeys put the pedal to the metal in their final attempt to finish the 1972 Buick Riviera super-build in time for SEMA; the team's integrity is on the line, and $300,000 has been invested, so failure is not an option. (Reality, Auto) - 2019-09-23

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Race Against Time
motortrend.us.description: Richard Rawlings and his crew of Monkeys race to finish a replica 1937 Buick Indy Racer for a deep-pocket client; the 1975 Datsun 280 Z draws a buyer, sending Richard racing to the bank. (Reality, Auto) - 2020-04-20

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Super Troupe Jeep
motortrend.us.description: Gas Monkey teams up with the Gary Sinise Foundation to build a custom '81 Jeep CJ7 as a throwback tribute to the soldiers for Veterans Day; an original '68 Chevelle has Richard seeing green but only if he can part with his California dream.

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Wranglin' World Records
motortrend.us.description: The team works on a 2018 Jeep Wrangler, the second Jeep they renew for Veterans Day; Richards makes a deal for a 1955 Crown Vic.

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Quick-Flippin' a Caddy
motortrend.us.description: Richard pays big bucks hoping to use a '63 Cadillac for a quick flip project; the guys do a bang-up job on a budget, but Jason goes rogue and risks tanking the whole thing.

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Super Troupe Jeep
motortrend.us.description: Gas Monkey teams up with the Gary Sinise Foundation to build a custom '81 Jeep CJ7 as a throwback tribute to the soldiers for Veterans Day; an original '68 Chevelle has Richard seeing green but only if he can part with his California dream.

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Wranglin' World Records
motortrend.us.description: The team works on a 2018 Jeep Wrangler, the second Jeep they renew for Veterans Day; Richards makes a deal for a 1955 Crown Vic.

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Quick-Flippin' a Caddy
motortrend.us.description: Richard pays big bucks hoping to use a '63 Cadillac for a quick flip project; the guys do a bang-up job on a budget, but Jason goes rogue and risks tanking the whole thing.

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Race Against Time
motortrend.us.description: Richard Rawlings and his crew of Monkeys race to finish a replica 1937 Buick Indy Racer for a deep-pocket client; the 1975 Datsun 280 Z draws a buyer, sending Richard racing to the bank.

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Vintage Payday
motortrend.us.description: Richard races toward a vintage payday by restoring his '37 Buick Racer back to its Indy 500 roots; the guys buy a one-owner '77 Blazer that could fetch them double their money; a surprise birthday gift has Richard feeling nostalgic.

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - No Second Chances
motortrend.us.description: The Monkeys put the pedal to the metal in their final attempt to finish the 1972 Buick Riviera super-build in time for SEMA; the team's integrity is on the line, and $300,000 has been invested, so failure is not an option.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - The Faster Pastor
motortrend.us.description: The Garage Squad needs some divine intervention to get this pastor's hulk of a '74 Bronco out of garage hell.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - Grandma Loves Her Nova
motortrend.us.description: This Nova has been in the family for three generations and seen more that its share of rough patches; now the grandson is on a mission with the Garage Squad to bring it back to glory for Grandma.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - 56 Ford Truck
motortrend.us.description: After years sitting in storage in a corn crib a 1956 Ford Truck gets some TLC; does the old girl have enough life left, to get her back out on the road?

motortrend.us.title: My Classic Car - Monkeemobile and Greased Lightning
motortrend.us.description: My Classic Car captures America's love affair with the automobile! Dennis Gage, the handlebar mustachioed host, takes you along for the ride and keeps it entertaining with his unique perspective and enthusiasm for all things automotive.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - F-Rod Begins and Cougar Ends!
motortrend.us.description: David and Steve encounter further issues with the Bang-Shifting Cougar.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - It's Alive: The F-Rod Lives!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich get the F-Rod 1931 Model A fired up and ready for racing.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Fail Guy vs. the V-10: Work Truck Battle
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich beat on David's '99 Dodge Ram and Steve's '73 Chevy.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - General Mayhem Returns to Its 440 Roots!
motortrend.us.description: The legendary '68 Dodge Charger General Mayhem gets stripped of its 707-hp Hellcat engine and all the related electronics; Freiburger and Dulcich vow to take it from the drag strip setup back to its motorhome 440-powered V8 and gravel-chucking roots.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Closer to Perfection: The '56 Chevy!
motortrend.us.description: The COVID-350-powered, six-speed 1956 Chevy Bel Air may sport 500 hp, but is far from perfection; Freiburger and Dulcich bring it closer to reaching their goals with some weight reduction, suspension modifications and a new 9-inch rear end.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - 1967 Cougar Die-Hard Redemption!
motortrend.us.description: Steve Dulcich enlists the help of crew member and fellow '80s action-movie enthusiast Wiley Stevens to get the '67 Bang Shifting Cougar back on the road; the guys install a new trans, suspension and custom hood, among other upgrades.

motortrend.us.title: Build for Off-Road - West Adventure Ride Part 1
motortrend.us.description: This year's Adventure Ride kicks off out west on the Rimrocker Trail, taking the team from Montrose, Colo. to Moab, Utah; along the way, the crew finds places to camp, while putting their rigs and overlanding skills to the test.

motortrend.us.title: Build for Off-Road - West Adventure Ride Part 2
motortrend.us.description: We finish the Rimrocker Trail and roll into Moab, Utah; but the adventure is just getting started as we tackle the obstacles of Behind the Rocks, then cap it all off with one of the most breathtaking trails in the country, Top of the World.

motortrend.us.title: Truck U - Willys Pickup Kickoff
motortrend.us.description: The 1951 Willys pickup that Matt Steele got from Willie B last year is in the shop for the first time. We will build a new firewall, tear down the engine for some new upgrades, and build out the Dana 44 axles that will end up under the truck.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Return of the Crop Duster!
motortrend.us.description: After years of paint and body work, it's finally time to piece the Crop Duster back to life, so the guys get the engine and transmission back in the freshly painted beauty after adding some extra cubic inches.

motortrend.us.title: Build for Off-Road - West Adventure Ride Part 3
motortrend.us.description: After coming down from the top of the World, the team takes on one of Moab's trails, Hell's Revenge; with drop-offs, steep climbs and the infamous Hell's Gate, this trail puts both the rigs and drivers to the ultimate test.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Body Swap, Street Dragging '56 Chevy!
motortrend.us.description: David and Steve nab a '56 Chevy 210 that was once an NHRA champion, but the body is complete garbage; they try to bring the car closer to its former glory, then it's off for some passes at the Kingman Street Drags on Route 66.

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Camaros, Impalas, Goodguys, Oh My
motortrend.us.description: Shorty's buddy Tommy has a '69 Camaro that needs some love, with damaged paint on the hood and malfunctioning headlight motors; another friend, T-bone, stops by with his '65 Impala for an air ride, updated interior and repainted steering wheel.

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - The Chupacabra Firebird
motortrend.us.description: Shorty's friend Porkchop wants to turn a '69 Firebird convertible into a tribute Trans Am for his wife; Shorty and his team transform the car with a new spoiler, motor mods with AC and fuel injection, custom interior and custom racing stripes.

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Supercharged Nova and a 9/11 Tribute Truck
motortrend.us.description: Arturo is a good friend of the shop, and his classic Nova will be a monster, with a rebuilt supercharged 6.2 LS, plus upgrades to the chassis and brakes; the crew revives a classic 1924 LaFrance fire truck for the nearby Cedar Hill Fire Department.

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Laid-Out Dually and Amber Glow Hemi
motortrend.us.description: An Amber Glow 1955 DeSoto might be pink, but it has a hemi under the hood; 2000 Chevy dually is a monster, but needs a new paint job, interior and air ride system.

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Finishing the Ember Glow Hemi
motortrend.us.description: Shorty tries to match the Ember Glow hemi's original color, then works his magic in the paint booth; Joel tries to figure out how to install an aftermarket AC; PG works on the interior; the crew is left with an enormous amount of trim. (Auto) - 2023-11-29

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Training Day Lowrider
motortrend.us.description: A big fan of the movie "Training Day" wants his '78 Monte Carlo to be built in the same vein; the G-body needs the works, including a swapped LS, beefed-up brakes and suspension and a new interior; Shorty's G10 parts runner van needs a facelift. (Auto) - 2023-12-06

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - One-of-a-Kind Widebody
motortrend.us.description: Shorty's right-hand man in the body shop, Joe Gomez, has been in remission from cancer for nearly 10 years and wants to create a wide body Honda Accord for his wife to show his appreciation. (Auto) - 2023-12-13

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Caleb's Corvette Part 1
motortrend.us.description: After losing a grandson in a racetrack crash, Rick Wilson and his family want to raise money to promote safety at tracks around Texas; they enlist Shorty and the team to build a 1956 Corvette that will be auctioned off for their cause. (Auto) - 2023-12-20

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Caleb's Corvette Part 2
motortrend.us.description: The '56 Corvette is complete, but not without a couple of twists; the family decides to change the body color from red to arctic blue with a silver teardrop; Shorty brings in the best in the business for a lowrider paint seminar at the shop. (Auto) - 2023-12-27

When her freewheeling ex-husband, Dusty (Mark Wahlberg), breezes back into town, Brad's feeling of insecurity quickly develops into an inferiority complex. As Dusty demonstrates his flair for athletics, home repair and bad-boy charisma, Whitaker finds himself in a no-holds-barred battle to one-up his rival and win the approval of his family. But, when his rival, Hansel (Owen Wilson), unexpectedly takes the crown, Derek is crushed. He becomes easy prey for fashion designer Jacobim Mugatu (Will Ferrell), who signs Derek to star in his Derelicte fashion show, then brainwashes him to kill Malaysia's prime minister. (Comedy, Action) - 2001

movies.us.title: Zoolander 2

Even more shocking is their encounter with Valentina Valencia, a special agent who needs their help. Someone is killing famous pop stars, and it's up to Derek and Hansel to help save the world's most beautiful people from a similar fate. (Comedy, Adventure) - 2016

A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board. (Science fiction, Dark comedy) - 1982

However, Frank has no evidence until he meets Jane Spencer (Priscilla Presley), Ludwig's assistant. She knows nothing about Ludwig's devious plans, but falls for Frank and agrees to help him. (Comedy) - 1988

movies.us.title: The Naked Gun 2 1/2: The Smell of Fear

They scheme to replace Meinheimer with an imposter who will do their bidding. pop.us.title: Law & Order - Enemy

screenpix.us.title: Two for the Seesaw
screenpix.us.description: After leaving his wife, lawyer Jerry Ryan (Robert Mitchum) moves from Omaha, Neb., to New York City to start a new life. While studying for the New York Bar Examination and working to finalize his divorce, Ryan meets dancer Gittel Mosca (Shirley MacLaine), and the two begin a cautious courtship. However, Ryan feels that he must come to terms with his failed marriage and overcome his lingering attachment to his ex-wife before he can redefine himself and embrace his budding romance. (Drama) - 1962

screenpix.us.title: The White Bus
screenpix.us.description: A young woman (Patricia Healey) is removed from her suicidal London life and taken home to North England. (Drama) - 1967

screenpix.us.title: Odds Against Tomorrow
screenpix.us.description: Disgraced former police officer David Burke (Ed Begley) is looking for a way to make some quick money. When he decides to rob a bank, he calls on mean ex-con Earle Slater (Robert Ryan) and black entertainer Johnny Ingram (Harry Belafonte) to help him pull off the heist. Johnny is reluctant to agree but is forced to reconsider because of his significant gambling debts, while racist Earle balks because of Johnny's involvement. Ultimately, though, they must work together to get the job done. (Crime drama) - 1959

screenpix.us.title: The World of Henry Orient
screenpix.us.description: While trying to seduce a married woman (Paula Prentiss), egotistical concert pianist Henry Orient (Peter Sellers) is interrupted by two precocious schoolgirls, Valerie (Tippy Walker) and Marian (Merrie Spaeth). At first, he thinks nothing of it, but as he sees them more often, he becomes convinced they're spies for his lover's husband. The girls, meanwhile, have found out who he is, and Valerie insists she's in love. She starts a scrapbook, which her mother finds and, of course, misconstrues. (Comedy) - 1964

screenpix.us.title: Diary of a High School Bride
screenpix.us.description: A girl (Anita Sands), 17, and her husband (Ronald Foster), 24, bring a shocking end to the problem of her ex-boyfriend (Chris Robinson). (Drama) - 1959

screenpix.us.title: The Clown and the Kid
screenpix.us.description: A clown's (Don Keefer) orphaned son (Mike McGreevey) unwittingly helps a convict (John Lupton) escape police with his father's makeup. (Drama) - 1961

screenpix.us.title: The Big Knife
screenpix.us.description: Movie star Charles Castle draws the ire of Hollywood producer Stanley Hoff when he refuses to sign a new seven-year contract. Castle is sick of the low quality of the studio's films and wants to start a new life. While his estranged wife supports him in the decision, Castle's talent agent urges him to reconsider. When Castle continues to be uncooperative, Hoff resorts to blackmail in order to get his way. (Drama) - 1955

screenpix.us.title: A Woman Possessed
screenpix.us.description: A man feels torn between allegiances to his mother and to his fiancée. (Drama) - 1958

screenpix.us.title: By Love Possessed
screenpix.us.description: After his wife, Clarissa (Barbara Bel Geddes), accuses him of being incapable of love, prominent Massachusetts lawyer Arthur Winner (Efrem Zimbalist Jr.) begins a torrid affair with the alcoholic spouse (Lana Turner) of his sexually disabled business partner Julius Penrose (Jason Robards Jr.). Arthur also struggles in his attempts to persuade his wayward son Warren (George Hamilton) to become a lawyer like him -- even though his own career brought him neither fulfillment nor emotional stability. (Romance) - 1961

screenpix.us.title: Lost Lagoon
screenpix.us.description: Charlie Walker (Jeffrey Lynn), a middle-aged businessman, grows weary of his middle-class life and his family. The stress gets so bad that Walker flees his responsibilities and takes to the open sea in his boat. A storm destroys the vessel, and he winds up stranded on a Caribbean island. Once there, he mixes with the locals and falls in love with a younger woman, Elizabeth Moore (Leila Barry). But Walker starts to feel the strain of his new life and wonders if he made the right decision. (Drama) - 1958

screenpix.us.title: The Haunted Palace
screenpix.us.description: Condemned warlock Joseph Curwen curses a New England village just before being burned alive. More than a century later, Curwen's kindly great-great-grandson Charles Ward (also Price) arrives in town and moves into Curwen's old mansion. Caretaker Simon Orne helps Charles and his wife Ann adjust to their new home. The ancient curse, however, takes hold of Joseph, awakening inside him a long-dormant evil passed on through blood. (Horror) - 1963

screenpix.us.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
screenpix.us.description: Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Doctor Watson (Andre Morell) meet with a certain Dr. Mortimer (Francis De Wolff), who tells them of the legend of the "hound," born out of a murder committed by Sir Hugo Baskerville centuries ago. Explaining that Sir Charles Baskerville recently died in the same location as Sir Hugo, Mortimer expresses his deep concern that Sir Henry, the heir to the Baskerville estate, will also fall prey to the evil hound's curse. Holmes sets out to investigate. (Mystery, Horror) - 1959

screenpix.us.title: Vampires on Bikini Beach
screenpix.us.description: Californians (Jennifer Badham, Todd Kaufman) try to save their beach from a ghoul and his gang. - 1988

screenpix.us.title: Tower of London
screenpix.us.description: Roger Corman's remake of the 1939 classic about Richard III's murderous rise to power in 15th-century England. - 1962

screenpix.us.title: The Masque of the Red Death
screenpix.us.description: A tyrannical 12th-century prince is intrigued by a girl and takes her to live amid the immorality of his court. - 1964

screenpix.us.title: Lord of Illusions
screenpix.us.description: A private eye (Scott Bakula) looks after the wife (Famke Janssen) of an illusionist (Kevin J. O'Connor) who killed his mentor, the leader of a black-magic cult. - 1995

screenpix.us.title: A Tale of Two Cities
screenpix.us.description: Dickens' London-lawyer hero (Dirk Bogarde) makes a great sacrifice for the woman (Dorothy Tutin) he loves in Reign of Terror Paris. - 1958

screenpix.us.title: The 7th Dawn
screenpix.us.description: An American (William Holden), his mistress (Capucine), the British and a communist clash in circa-1945 Malaya. - 1964

screenpix.us.title: Shake Hands With the Devil
screenpix.us.description: A medical professor (James Cagney) recruits a U.S. student (Don Murray) for the Irish Republican Army in 1921 Dublin. - 1959

screenpix.us.title: The Haunted Palace
screenpix.us.description: A man (Vincent Price) and wife (Debra Paget) claim the mansion of his great-great-grandfather, a warlock burned alive in 1765. - 1963

screenpix.us.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
screenpix.us.description: Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson (Andre Morell) protect Sir Henry (Christopher Lee) from a killer-dog family curse. - 1959

screenpix.us.title: Attack!
screenpix.us.description: Lt. Joe Costa (Jack Palance) is a part of Fragile Fox Company, a National Guard unit sent to a Belgian town in the final stages of World War II. Costa harbors some serious doubts about the leadership abilities of Captain Cooney (Eddie Albert), a coward who only secured his position because of his ties to Lt. Col. Bartlett (Lee Marvin). Cooney's inexperience and his open contempt for Costa threaten the lives of his men as they draw closer to Battle of the Bulge. (War, Drama) - 1956

screenpix.us.title: Kings Go Forth
screenpix.us.description: During World War II, in a picturesque town on the French Riviera, U.S. Army Lt. Sam Loggins (Frank Sinatra) and Cpl. Britt Harris (Tony Curtis) both fall for the same local girl, the American-born Monique Blair (Natalie Wood). But when the soldiers learn that Monique and her mother (Leora Dana) had moved to France from the United States to escape discrimination against her parents' interracial marriage, each man must examine his own bigotry and prejudices. (War, Drama) - 1958

screenpix.us.title: Pork Chop Hill
screenpix.us.description: Because final peace negotiations are bogged down in political maneuvering, U.S. soldiers, led by Lt. Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck), are forced to assault entrenched Chinese troops. The site of battle is Pork Chop Hill, a daunting, desolate climb that gives the communist forces a clear advantage. Clash after deadly clash wears down the morale and readiness of Clemons' men, and when they ask for backup, command is neither willing to send reinforcements nor authorize a retreat. (War, Drama) - 1959

screenpix.us.title: Cast a Giant Shadow
screenpix.us.description: In this fact-based film, distinguished U.S. Army Col. David Marcus (Kirk Douglas) is enlisted by the Israelis to perform the difficult task of preparing their fledgling nation for battle against the Arabs. Before long, he feuds with the local leaders, quits his post and goes back home to his pregnant wife (Angie Dickinson) in the United States. However, Marcus, who is Jewish himself, soon has a crisis of faith and decides to return to duty to help the untrained Israelis form an army. (War) - 1966

screenpix.us.title: Operation Bikini
screenpix.us.description: During World War II, a U.S. submarine under the command of Capt. Emmett Carey (Scott Brady) takes on the underwater demolition team of Lt. Morgan Hayes (Tab Hunter) -- which includes Seaman Joseph Malzone (Frankie Avalon) -- when the radar equipment of a sunken ship needs to be destroyed. Reaching their target at Bikini Atoll, they find the area full of hostile enemies and helpful guerrillas, including the stunning Reiko (Eva Six), with whom Hayes develops a relationship during the mission. (War) - 1963

screenpixaction.us.title: The Initiation of Sarah
screenpixaction.us.description: When a coed is humiliated by a group of sorority sisters, she is urged to get even by unleashing her psychic powers. (Horror) - 1978

screenpixaction.us.title: The Satan Bug
screenpixaction.us.description: Special Agent Lee Barrett (George Maharis) joins forces with Ann Williams (Anne Francis), a general's daughter, to recover a biological weapon stolen from a secret government lab. Learning that the pathogen could destroy all life on Earth, they focus their attention on a mysterious millionaire who may have orchestrated the theft. After annihilating a small town in Florida, the villain turns his attention to Los Angeles -- and the duo must race to stop the city's destruction. (Science fiction) - 1965

screenpixaction.us.title: The Manster
screenpixaction.us.description: A Japanese scientist's (Tetsu Nakamura) injection splits a U.S. reporter (Peter Dyneley) into man and ape-man. (Science fiction) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: The Vampire
screenpixaction.us.description: A small-town doctor (John Beal) cannot stop taking the pills that turn him into a fanged killer. (Horror) - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: Sometimes They Come Back
screenpixaction.us.description: High school teacher Jim Norman (Tim Matheson) reluctantly returns to his hometown with his wife (Brooke Adams) to pursue a job. Jim is haunted by the childhood memory of his brother being murdered by a group of teenagers, who were then struck by a train before they could kill him, too. To Jim's horror, he finds that the teenagers have returned to town as they appeared before they died, and are transferring into his class. When his students start dying off, Jim becomes the prime suspect. (Horror) - 1991

screenpixaction.us.title: The Gravedancers
screenpixaction.us.description: After a funeral, several college friends reunite in a cemetery and reminisce about the former life of the deceased. The celebration starts to go too far after they get drunk and begin dancing on graves, and as a result, each of them becomes haunted by malevolent spirits. (Horror, Thriller) - 2006

screenpixaction.us.title: Lovers Lane
screenpixaction.us.description: A man with a hook for a hand escapes from a mental institution to go after the children of his previous victims. (Horror) - 1999

screenpixaction.us.title: Scissors
screenpixaction.us.description: In the wake of a brutal assault suffered at the hands of a red-bearded stranger, Angie Anderson (Sharon Stone) is grappling with her own sanity. To heal her scarred psyche, her therapist (Ronny Cox) urges hypnotherapy, which causes her to face gruesome truths from her past. Not long after getting entangled in a sordid love triangle with twin brothers, Alex (Steve Railsback) and Cole (also Railsback), Angie is lured into a twisted trap that threatens to unravel what little sanity she has left. (Horror) - 1991

screenpixaction.us.title: Scarecrows
screenpixaction.us.description: Bank robbers parachute from a hijacked plane into a field full of killer scarecrows. (Horror) - 1988

screenpixaction.us.title: The Initiation of Sarah
screenpixaction.us.description: When a coed is humiliated by a group of sorority sisters, she is urged to get even by unleashing her psychic powers. (Horror) - 1978

screenpixaction.us.title: The Black Sleep
screenpixaction.us.description: Victorian Sir Joel (Basil Rathbone) prepares for his wife's brain surgery by practicing on locals supplied by a Gypsy (Akim Tamiroff). (Horror, Science fiction) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: The Blood on Satan's Claw
screenpixaction.us.description: When a mysterious corpse is accidentally dug up by a boy in a small town, a group of local teens starts acting very strangely. The adolescents, led by a girl named Angel (Linda Hayden), are convinced the corpse was once possessed. Hoping to get in touch with the devil through the body, the teens act out a series of demonic rituals that causes a stir among the townspeople. When word of the satanic activity spreads, certain parents start trying to lock up the kids behind the spooky stunts. (Horror) - 1971

screenpixaction.us.title: Blood Bath
screenpixaction.us.description: A reincarnated 15th-century vampire sets his sights on the women of modern-day California. Produced by Roger Corman. - 1966

screenpixaction.us.title: Pharaoh's Curse
screenpixaction.us.description: Archaeologists open a tomb in the Valley of the Kings and feel a mummy's wrath. - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: Curse of the Faceless Man
screenpixaction.us.description: A scientist's (Richard Anderson) girlfriend (Elaine Edwards) is kidnapped by a stony Etruscan gladiator-slave found near Pompeii. - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: Curse of the Swamp Creature
screenpixaction.us.description: Geologists in the Florida Everglades stumble upon a mad scientist's secret lab and his experimental man-beasts. - 1966

screenpixaction.us.title: Black Sabbath
screenpixaction.us.description: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff). - 1963

screenpixaction.us.title: Konga
screenpixaction.us.description: A botanist's experiments with primates and plant serum transform a lovable chimpanzee into a giant killer gorilla. - 1961

screenpixaction.us.title: Die, Monster, Die!
screenpixaction.us.description: An American (Nick Adams) in England finds plants, animals and his future in-laws (Boris Karloff, Freda Jackson) mutated by a meteorite. - 1965

screenpixaction.us.title: The Emerald Forest
screenpixaction.us.description: A U.S. engineer (Powers Boothe) finds his long-lost son (Charley Boorman) in the Amazon, dyed green with a Stone Age tribe. - 1985

screenpixaction.us.title: The Beasts of Marseilles
screenpixaction.us.description: Two British prisoners of war (Stephen Boyd, Tony Wright) escape to France and try to get past Nazis and a deadly doctor (James Robertson Justice). - 1959

screenpixaction.us.description: A judge (Patrick Wymark) tries to stop a witch named Angel (Linda Hayden) and her coven of children in 17th-century England. - 1971
