screenpixaction.us.title: Rage
screenpixaction.us.description: The adopted son from a prominent Asian business family lives the perfect life until his rival stepbrother launches a murder conspiracy plot in order to take over the family's multi-billion dollar trading corporation. (Action, Drama, Martial arts) - 1992

screenpixaction.us.title: The Lone Runner
screenpixaction.us.description: A bounty hunter (Miles O'Keeffe) on horseback rescues a European damsel (Savina Gersak), using only a crossbow and explosive arrows. (Adventure) - 1986

screenpixaction.us.title: Soldier Boyz
screenpixaction.us.description: Veteran Howard Toliver (Michael Dudikoff) works at a prison for extremely dangerous juvenile offenders. Recruited to rescue a wealthy girl being held captive in Vietnam, he assembles a team composed of some of the most violent inmates, many of whom are enemies. After battling their way through the jungle, they lay siege to the fortress of the brutal warlord Vinh Moc (Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa), who has the hostage hidden away. Will they work together, or allow their rivalries to consume them? (Action) - 1995

screenpixaction.us.title: Hercules Against Karate
screenpixaction.us.description: Two martial artists go to Hong Kong to rescue a restaurateur's son from the clutches of an evil kung fu master. (Action) - 1973

screenpixaction.us.title: Born Losers
screenpixaction.us.description: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy. (Crime drama) - 1967

screenpixaction.us.title: The Devil's Brigade
screenpixaction.us.description: At the onset of World War II, American Lt. Col. Robert Frederick (William Holden) is put in charge of a unit called the 1st Special Service Force, composed of elite Canadian commandos and undisciplined American soldiers. With Maj. Alan Crown (Cliff Robertson) leading the Canadians and Maj. Cliff Bricker (Vince Edwards) the acting head of the American contingent, there is initial tension -- but the team comes together when given a daunting mission that few would dare to attempt. (War, Drama) - 1968

screenpixvoices.us.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
screenpixvoices.us.description: In this sequel to "In The Heat of the Night," Detective Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier) must solve the murder of a prostitute. The last person witnessed with the victim is Tibbs' friend, Logan Sharpe (Martin Landau), a preacher and activist. Despite his loyalty, Tibbs must investigate when Sharpe admits having visited the prostitute. In addition to his police work, Tibbs must also ease tension with his wife (Barbara McNair), who wants him to spend more time with her and their children. (Crime drama) - 1970

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Limbic Region
screenpixvoices.us.description: In San Francisco in the 1970s, a serial killer calling himself The Scorekeeper sends taunting notes to the police and media after each of his kills. Although the case is long closed, obsessed detective Jon Lucca (Edward James Olmos) still suspects the wrong man was named as the killer. Learning he has only weeks to live, Lucca meets with Lloyd Ward (George Dzundza) -- the man he has long been convinced is the murderer, but never had enough evidence to arrest -- intending to force a confession. (Thriller) - 1996

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Ambush Murders
screenpixvoices.us.description: A white lawyer (James Brolin) defends an activist (Dorian Harewood) accused of killing two policemen in a racially tense town. (Drama) - 1982

screenpixvoices.us.title: Deadly Intent
screenpixvoices.us.description: An adventurer's boss (Maud Adams) and other villains want his widow (Lisa Eilbacher) to lead them to his South American jewels. (Thriller) - 1988

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hell up in Harlem
screenpixvoices.us.description: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world. (Crime drama) - 1973

screenpixvoices.us.title: Sugar Hill
screenpixvoices.us.description: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancée, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers. (Horror) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: Blacula
screenpixvoices.us.description: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail. (Horror) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Scream Blacula Scream
screenpixvoices.us.description: When a hated rival, Lisa Fortier (Pam Grier), is chosen to lead the voodoo cult of Willis Daniels' (Richard Lawson) late mother, a vengeful Willis brings the doomed vampire Prince Mamuwalde (William Marshall) back to life. Willis soon finds the vampire too powerful to control, and Lisa agrees to perform a spell that will break the curse placed on the prince. But, when racist sheriff Dunlop (Michael Conrad) gets involved, the vampire unleashes his deadly revenge. (Horror) - 1973

screenpixvoices.us.title: J.D.'s Revenge
screenpixvoices.us.description: The spirit of a zoot-suited, razor-wielding 1940s hoodlum possesses a New Orleans law student (Glynn Turman). - 1976

screenpixvoices.us.description: A Los Angeles policeman (Lou Diamond Phillips) hunts a killer (Jeff Kober) brought back from the gas chamber by Satan. - 1990

screenpixvoices.us.description: Detectives Barzak and Hazeltine are trying their hardest to bring down a drug ring, but they're meeting with trouble at every turn, which leads the officers to suspect a mole in their midst. When the detectives are dissuaded by their superiors from following a lead about the man behind the whole operation, Barzak and Hazeltine are forced to find the truth on their own without the support of their department. (Crime drama) - 1987

screenpixvoices.us.title: Black Mama, White Mama
screenpixvoices.us.description: Lee Daniels (Pam Grier) is a black girl busted for prostitution. Karen Brent (Margaret Markov) is a white girl arrested for her involvement with a local revolutionary group. The two women meet in jail and, despite their mutual animosity, are chained together for transport to a maximum security prison. Their bus is ambushed en route, however, and the pair manages to escape together. Chased by bounty hunters, crooked police and revolutionaries, they struggle to get along and get away. (Action) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Defiant Ones
screenpixvoices.us.description: Two men (Robert Urich, Carl Weathers) of different races, who loathe each other, escape from a chain gang shackled together. (Crime drama) - 1986

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hickey & Boggs
screenpixvoices.us.description: Two Los Angeles private eyes (Bill Cosby, Robert Culp) find a missing woman and follow her to loot from a Pittsburgh bank. (Crime drama) - 1972

skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hook
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Annie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Daddy Warbucks opens his estate to a spunky orphan in this adaptation of the popular comic strip and hit Broadway show.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Too
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Now
skycinemafamily.uk.description: In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village
skycinemafamily.uk.description: With the evil wizard Gargamel hot on their trail, Smurfette, Brainy, Clumsy and Hefty embark on a journey through the Forbidden Forest to find a mysterious village.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Monster House
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young boy and his pals set out to discover what bloodcurdling secrets lie behind the front door of the scary house across the street.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hotel Transylvania
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenage daughter.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula decides to put his grandson through 'monster' boot camp. Then, Dracula's father unexpectedly pays a visit.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Despicable Me
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When his wickedness is challenged, supervillain Gru hatches a plan to steal the moon. Enlisting three young orphans to help out, his dastardly plot is derailed when he begins to care for them.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Despicable Me 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Just as a retired villain settles into his new role as a suburban family man, the ultra-secret Anti-Villain League sends him on a mission to nab the perpetrator of a spectacular heist.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Despicable Me 3
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Fired from the Anti-Villain League, Gru travels to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother. The siblings soon find themselves in an uneasy alliance to take down Balthazar Bratt, a former 1980s child star who wants to take down the world.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jumanji
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when a video game magically transports them to the jungle and transforms them into adults.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When Spencer goes back into the fantastical world of Jumanji, pals Martha, Fridge and Bethany re-enter the game to bring him home. But everything about Jumanji is about to change, as they soon discover more obstacles and more danger to overcome.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Golden Compass
skycinemafamily.uk.description: In a parallel universe, a young girl called Lyra comes into possession of a magical compass that is the beginning of an epic quest to save her world.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Borrowers
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from 'Monster Family' to 'The Amazing Maurice'.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Karate Kid: Legends
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Rugrats Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

starz.us.description: A covert team of elite operatives live in the global shadows, as comfortable wielding power and influence as they are automatic weapons and high explosives. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, the team is sent to steal it back on what would be for anyone else a suicide mission. What begins as an impossible heist gets worse, spiraling into an all-out war of strategy, deception and survival. (Action, Thriller) - 2026

starz.us.title: Beast
starz.us.description: After years away from the cage, a once-feared MMA champion is pulled back in for the fight of his life when his younger brother is put in danger. teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Friended! With the Casagrandes
teennick.us.description: Ronnie Anne makes friends with Sid, a girl whose family wants to rent the apartment upstairs; when it looks like another couple might get it first, the girls resort to sabotage to try and dissuade them.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Deal Me Out; Friendzy
teennick.us.description: Lincoln and Clyde worry that they may be too old to still be playing Ace Savvy; Lincoln discovers that having a friend over means getting special privileges, and he takes advantage of that.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Kick the Bucket List; Party Down
teennick.us.description: Lincoln and Clyde's spring break plans are put in jeopardy when they only have one day to complete their list; Lori throws a sophisticated party, but it backfires when her guests do not like what she has planned.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Ghosted!
teennick.us.description: Lori banishes a ghost she believes is haunting her, but when Fairway's golf team starts to struggle, she realizes she needs to bring it back to turn the team's luck around.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Face the Music With the Casagrandes; Pranks for the Memories With the Casagrandes
teennick.us.description: When Ronnie Anne discovers that each family member will perform at Hector's birthday, she turns to Sid for help; Ronnie Anne's attempts to bond with her cool older cousin Carlota lead to a prank war against the boy cousins.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - City Slickers; Fool Me Twice
teennick.us.description: Lori and Lincoln visit the city, where Lori struggles to be a city girl; Lincoln finds that Ronnie Anne has changed; the family uses stunt doubles in its plan to avoid Luan's April Fool's Day pranking.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Road Trip: Screen Queen; Road Trip: Hide and Sneak
teennick.us.description: When the Louds' road trip takes them to Hollywood, Lola is determined to become a star and land a leading role; to help Mom make the deadline for her column, the Louds have to avoid the Casagrandes when they visit Great Lakes City.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Present Danger; Stressed for the Part
teennick.us.description: Dressed as David Steele, Lincoln is on the hunt for his stolen birthday present before it's destroyed; after landing a role in a Dairyland production, Luan must hide this news from Mrs. Bernardo, whom she beat out.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Selfie Improvement; No Place Like Homeschool
teennick.us.description: When Carol Pingrey's photograph gets more "likes" on social media than Lori's, she tries to one-up her; thinking it looks like fun, the other kids try to get in on Lola's home-schooling.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Fool's Paradise; Job Insecurity
teennick.us.description: The Loud family believe that they are safe from pranks on April Fool's Day because prankster Luan is away at camp; when the children discover that their father is not at his old job anymore, they begin to worry it might be their fault.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Taunting Hour; Musical Chairs
teennick.us.description: Lincoln convinces his teacher, Mr. Bolhofner, to join the Doo-Dads to get a better seat in class; after Lincoln tries to help Lynn get over a heckler at her soccer game, the Louds realize they all have critics.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Flip This Flip; Haunted House Call
teennick.us.description: The Loud kids help Flip clean up his image to impress his middle school crush; when the Mortician's Club can't afford tickets to Casket Con, they decide to start a business to raise money.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Grub Snub; She's All Bat
teennick.us.description: When Leni and her friends start hanging out at Gus', Lincoln and the gang start a turf war for control; Lucy gets jealous of Lola's newfound attention after she joins the Mortician's Club.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - House of Lies; Game Boys
teennick.us.description: After witnessing an excess of lying in the family, Lisa invents lie-detecting glasses to try and curb the fibs; Lincoln asks to borrow Clyde's new gaming system, but Clyde struggles to trust that it's safe with him.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Scream Machine
teennick.us.description: When Charlotte's invention for a TV show is accidentally destroyed and then rebuilt, Charlotte worries that the attention she gets could expose Kid Danger and Captain Man's secret identity.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Time Jerker
teennick.us.description: When Kid Danger and Captain Man battle the Time Jerker, Kid Danger accidentally falls into the Time Jerker's time machine and relives the same day over again.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Opposite Universe
teennick.us.description: Henry and Charlotte travel to an opposite universe where evil counterparts of Ray and Schwoz want to destroy Piper.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Secret Beef
teennick.us.description: Henry receives an invitation to Swellview's most exclusive restaurant, and decides to bring his boss, Ray.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Jasper Danger
teennick.us.description: When Jasper dresses as Kid Danger for Halloween, a case of mistaken identity causes the real Kid Danger and Captain Man to come to his rescue.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Man: On Vacation
teennick.us.description: Henry and Charlotte are in charge of protecting Swellview while Ray is out of town at his cousin's wedding.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Stuck in Two Holes
teennick.us.description: Charlotte and Jasper must come to the rescue when Captain Man and Kid Danger are each stuck in a hole.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Secret Room
teennick.us.description: Captain Man reveals a Crime fighters Only room in the Man Cave; when Charlotte, Jasper and Schwoz make a cooler room to show them up, the gang fights over who gets the better room and things get blown out of proportion.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Super Volcano
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray think the world is ending when a dormant super volcano under Swellview becomes active; Piper is convinced that she has gluten intolerance.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Story Tank
teennick.us.description: Big steaks are on the line when Henry claims he can't be scared; Schwoz uses a machine that allows Henry to virtually experience the spooky stories that everyone in the Man Cave tells him in an attempt to prove Henry wrong.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Man of the House
teennick.us.description: After Henry's mother's purse is stolen, Captain Man decides he must move in with Henry's family in order to protect them.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Invisible Brad
teennick.us.description: Captain Man's friend, who was accidentally turned invisible, shows up for a visit, but quickly overstays his welcome.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Twin Henrys
teennick.us.description: Henry has a shape-shifting android fill in at a family dinner so that he can watch an MMA fight with Charlotte and Ray.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Game of Phones
teennick.us.description: When a young girl chains herself outside Junk-N-Stuff, Kid Danger and Captain Man are forced to help find her beloved phone; while on a stakeout, they unexpectedly run across some familiar faces with a devious plan.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Toddler Invasion
teennick.us.description: When the Toddler takes control of the Man Cave, Charlotte and Jasper have to find a way to sneak in and free Kid Danger and Captain Man.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Budget Cuts
teennick.us.description: When the Vice Mayor cuts Captain Man and Kid Danger's budget to build a high-speed railway in Swellview, the duo must figure out creative ways to save money.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Flabber Gassed
teennick.us.description: After acting too confident before a fight, Kid Danger and Captain Man are sprayed with Flabber Gas making them powerless to defeat a new villain in Swellview; Schwoz puts the heroes in Exo-Suits which Charlotte and Jasper control.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Rubber Duck
teennick.us.description: When Ray accidentally destroys Henry's dad's prized remote control car, they throw a manicure/pedicure party to raise money to fix it.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Man-kini
teennick.us.description: When a new internet celebrity causes havoc in Swellview, Captain Man has to swap bodies with Frankini to infiltrate his secret lair. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-05-12

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Double-O Danger
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man attempt to capture mob boss Rob Moss by infiltrating his daughter's Sweet 16 birthday party. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-06-29

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Dream Busters
teennick.us.description: A villain's dream beam traps Henry in a dream state from which only Charlotte can rescue him. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-03-21

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Dodging Danger
teennick.us.description: After Henry uses his new power to compete in a Dodge-A-Leen tournament, Ray, Schwoz and Charlotte go undercover to teach Henry a lesson. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-12-03

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Kid Grounded
teennick.us.description: Henry is grounded after he is caught sneaking out at night; while Piper drives Henry crazy at home, Charlotte steps into the sidekick role. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-04-04

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Funny Business; Snow Bored
teennick.us.description: Lincoln begins to hog the spotlight when he becomes Luan's clown assistant; the Loud children have fun on a snow day. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-11-08

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Toads and Tiaras; Two Boys and a Baby
teennick.us.description: When Lola gets sick and is unable to compete in a pageant, Lincoln coaches Lana to take her place; thinking it will be easy, Lincoln and Clyde decide to take on the task of baby-sitting Lily. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-07-21

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Store Wars With the Casagrandes; Lucha Fever With the Casagrandes
teennick.us.description: When a fancy grocery store opens on the block, Bobby rallies the family to do everything they can to compete; Ronnie Anne fakes being sick to watch a Lucha Libre match, which proves to be more difficult than anticipated. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2019-06-20

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Bummer Camp; Sleepstakes
teennick.us.description: When Gramps struggles to run Camp Mastodon, the kids come to his rescue; the Loud kids help Lana get over her fear of sleepovers. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2022-06-10

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Cover Girls; Save the Date
teennick.us.description: Lincoln has his hands full when all 10 of his sisters ask him to cover for them on the same day; Bobby and Lori go on a double date with Lincoln and Bobby's little sister, Ronnie Anne. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-08-04

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Left in the Dark; Get the Message
teennick.us.description: Lincoln must beat each of his sisters to the couch in order to watch the finale of his favorite show; Lincoln leaves a scathing voicemail on Lori's phone, and quickly realizes that he must erase it before she hears it. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-02

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Along Came a Sister; Chore and Peace
teennick.us.description: Lincoln must care for the class tarantula; Lincoln decides to go on strike until someone will swap chores. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-04

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Driving Miss Hazy; No Guts, No Glori
teennick.us.description: Finally tired of doing favors for Lori to get rides, Lincoln decides to help Leni pass her driver's test; Lincoln and nine of his sisters work as a team to thwart the tyranny they face with Lori as their babysitter. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-10

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Linc or Swim; Changing the Baby
teennick.us.description: All ten of Lincoln's sisters want to use the new kiddie pool he has purchased, but it is not large enough for all of them; after noticing that none of his sisters share his interests, Lincoln tries to mold Lily into his mini-me. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-18

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Stall Monitor; A Pimple Plan
teennick.us.description: Worried that his teacher has bad things to say about him, Lincoln tries to delay his parent-teacher conference; Luan wakes up with a pimple on the day of her first date with Benny, so she turns to the siblings for help. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2019-11-09

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Diss the Cook; For Sale by Loner
teennick.us.description: Lincoln is convinced the middle school lunch lady is holding a grudge against him and his older sisters; Mr. Grouse attempts to find some peace and quiet after moving away from the Louds. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2021-11-12

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Camped!
teennick.us.description: When Dad discovers that his childhood camp is closing, he decides to take the family for one final visit; they soon uncover a map that could lead to a treasure big enough to save the camp and prove the existence of an old camp legend. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2021-05-31

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Snow Escape; Snow News Day
teennick.us.description: To make it to school, the Louds must survive a monstrous Lynn when the weatherman declares it a Packing Day; when there are signs of a yeti in Royal Woods, the Action News Team sets out to prove its existence. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2022-12-20

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Butterfly Effect; The Green House
teennick.us.description: Lincoln spills one of Lisa's experiments, setting off a chain reaction throughout the house; Lincoln tries to encourage the family to stop using so much electricity. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-06-08

themoviechannel.us.title: Our Ghosts
themoviechannel.us.description: Hiding in the attic of his former apartment, a widowed and jobless father tries to scare the new tenant so he can live there once again. (Comedy drama) - 2021

themoviechannel.us.title: The Aviator
themoviechannel.us.description: Billionaire and aviation tycoon Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a successful public figure: a director of big-budget Hollywood films such as "Hell's Angels," a passionate lover of Hollywood leading ladies Katharine Hepburn (Cate Blanchett) and Ava Gardner (Kate Beckinsale), and an aviation pioneer who helps build TWA into a major airline. But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Wakefield
themoviechannel.us.description: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned. (Drama) - 2016

themoviechannel.us.title: Red Eye
themoviechannel.us.description: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. (Action, Thriller) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: The Contractor
themoviechannel.us.description: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. (Action, Thriller) - 2022

themoviechannel.us.title: Paycheck
themoviechannel.us.description: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller, Mystery) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Along Came a Spider
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: Primal Fear
themoviechannel.us.description: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Barron's Cove
themoviechannel.us.description: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Gone Baby Gone
themoviechannel.us.description: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child. - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: Match Point
themoviechannel.us.description: A one-time tennis professional (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) becomes obsessed with his brother-in-law's (Matthew Goode) seductive fiancée (Scarlett Johansson). - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Basic Instinct
themoviechannel.us.description: A woman suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick ensnares a San Francisco cop in a web of lust and deceit. - 1992

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: A veteran cop (Billy Bob Thornton) and an assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen) track an ex-convict (Dwayne Johnson) who is on a mission to take revenge on his brother's killers. - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Red Eye
themoviechannel.us.description: A plane passenger (Cillian Murphy) forcibly involves his seatmate (Rachel McAdams) in a plot to assassinate a government official. - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Hugo
themoviechannel.us.description: A resourceful orphaned boy (Asa Butterfield) and a bookish girl (Chloë Grace Moretz) set out on a quest to unlock a secret left to him by the boy's late father (Jude Law). - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: The Brothers Grimm
themoviechannel.us.description: Itinerant con men (Matt Damon, Heath Ledger) become caught in a real fairy tale after several maidens disappear in an enchanted forest. - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: The Stepford Wives
themoviechannel.us.description: A man and his wife move to a quaint suburb where most of the women seem to have the same bland personality. - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 2
themoviechannel.us.description: A masked killer continues to pursue a California student (Neve Campbell) and her friends at an Ohio college. - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 3
themoviechannel.us.description: Murders draw a young woman (Neve Campbell), a reporter (Courteney Cox Arquette) and an ex-policeman (David Arquette) to the set of a movie inspired by horrific events that they survived. - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
themoviechannel.us.description: A blundering Los Angeles detective (Leslie Nielsen) and his boss (George Kennedy) foil a plan to assassinate Queen Elizabeth. - 1988

themoviechannel.us.title: Old School
themoviechannel.us.description: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. The following days go from bad to worse as Sylvia struggles to reach her most troubled students, bright underachiever Joe and sensitive Alice. turnerclassicmovies.us.title: In the Cool of the Day

When he introduces her to his co-worker, Murray Logan (Peter Finch), who is unhappily married to Sybil (Angela Lansbury), there are immediate sparks between Christine and Murray, and as their respective marriages disintegrate, the two begin to look for a way to be together. turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sunday in New York

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Thirteen Women

On the journey there, Helen meets Ursula Georgi (Myrna Loy), a half-Indian, unaware that Ursula's fury over her treatment in college is behind the swami's predictions. (Thriller) - 1932

moremax.us.title: Trap
moremax.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

moremax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
moremax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

moremax.us.title: DC League of Super-Pets
moremax.us.description: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2022

moremax.us.title: Miss Sloane
moremax.us.description: Willing to bend the rules for her clients, Elizabeth Sloane (Jessica Chastain) remains one of the most sought-after lobbyists in Washington, D.C. When asked to help oppose a bill that imposes regulations on firearms, she instead joins a scrappy boutique firm that represents the backers of the law. Her defiant stance and determination to win now makes her the target of powerful new enemies who threaten her career and the people she cares about. (Drama, Thriller) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Black Adam
moremax.us.description: In ancient Kahndaq, Teth Adam was bestowed the almighty powers of the gods. After using these powers for vengeance, he was imprisoned, becoming Black Adam. Nearly 5,000 years have passed, and Black Adam has gone from man to myth to legend. Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2022

moremax.us.title: Lady Bird
moremax.us.description: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school. (Comedy drama) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Mojave
moremax.us.description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home. (Thriller) - 2015

moremax.us.title: The Perfect Match
moremax.us.description: Charlie (Terrence J) is a charming playboy who doesn't believe in serious relationships. His best friends bet him that if he commits to one woman for one month, he's bound to fall in love. Charlie accepts the seemingly easy challenge, but wasn't expecting to cross paths with the beautiful and mysterious Eva (Cassie Ventura). When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
moremax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
moremax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: The Dilemma
moremax.us.description: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Spring Breakers
moremax.us.description: Four college friends (Vanessa Hudgens, Selena Gomez, Ashley Benson, Rachel Korine) are arrested after robbing a restaurant to fund their spring-break trip. They land in more trouble when a drug and arms dealer bails them out to do some dirty work. - 2012

moremax.us.description: A dying Secret Service agent (Kevin Costner) who wants to reconnect with his estranged daughter (Hailee Steinfeld) is offered a potentially lifesaving drug in exchange for completing one final mission. - 2014

moremax.us.title: The Nun
moremax.us.description: Vatican officials send a priest and a novitiate to investigate the suicide of a young nun in Romania. They soon find themselves in a fight for their lives when they encounter a demonic force that takes the shape of a nun. - 2018

moremax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
moremax.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

moremax.us.title: The Predator
moremax.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Nerve
moremax.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Thriller, Action, Adventure, Crime drama) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Scream
moremax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E21 The Twin Dilemma: Part 1 The mysterious Professor Edgeworth has kidnapped twin human child genii, Romulus and Remus, and Hugo Lang holds the new Doctor responsible for the destruction of his spaceship.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E22 The Twin Dilemma: Part 2 On Jaconda, Mestor’s cruel domination over the planet's population continues while on Titan Three, the Doctor seems to have been blown up in a booby-trapped building.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E23 The Twin Dilemma: Part 3 Mestor claims that all he wants is for the Sylvest twins to help him repopulate his home planet but the Doctor knows there’s more to this than meets the eye.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E24 The Twin Dilemma: Part 4 Mestor’s true plan is revealed and the Doctor's old Gallifreyan friend Azmael comes to the realisation that he has been corrupted long enough by the Gastropod leader.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E1 Attack of the Cybermen: Part 1 The Cybermen are hiding in the London sewers and turning humans into semi-cybernetic slaves. On Telos two slaves make a bid of freedom and find a way to escape the planet for good.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E2 Attack of the Cybermen: Part 2 On Telos the Doctor is reintroduced to the Cyber Leader and meets the Cryons, the planet’s original inhabitants who want their planet back and will go to any lengths to do so.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E3 Vengeance on Varos: Part 1 Needing Zeiton 7 ore urgently for the TARDIS, the Doctor takes Peri to Varos, but quickly become part of the sadistic programming that entertains the populace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E4 Vengeance on Varos: Part 2 As Peri and Areta begin to transform into a bird and a reptile, the Doctor faces Sil, who has negotiated mining rights on Varos, depriving the Time Lord of what he needs...

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E5 The Mark of the Rani: Part 1 People cannot sleep in the town of Killingworth and the Doctor realises it is the work of a renegade Time Lord, the Rani, who has teamed up with the Master to wreck chaos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E6 The Mark of the Rani: Part 2 George Stephenson and Luke Ward do their best to help the Doctor and Peri, but the Rani has other traps for the unwary, including the ability to turn people into trees...

Friends and adventure junkies, Megan and Tim hit the road to discover some of America's most unique vacation properties and meet the creative minds behind them. From Highland castles and homes built under airplanes to hobbit homes and earth domes. They'll explore incredible spaces, uncover their stories and find out what makes each stay truly one of a kind. Along the way, Megan brings her expert eye for design while Tim brings the fun, as they search for the ultimate unforgettable vacation stay. Get ready for an Outrageous adventure! (Travel) - 2026-10-24

wxix.us.description: Contestants must stand their ground on a massive, interactive LED game floor of squares, each representing a different trivia category. The first challenger, selected at random, must choose one of his or her neighboring opponents to go head-to-head in an epic quiz duel in the opponent's category. The winner takes over the loser's square, gaining valuable ground as they expand their territory, while the loser exits the game. cleotv.us.title: Cooking Sessions with Tamar & Ms. E - Family Favorites
cleotv.us.description: Tamar turns the kitchen over to Ms. E and her son Logan to prepare Logan's favorite meal; they make Salisbury steak, rice, and gravy with broccoli.

cleotv.us.title: Cooking Sessions with Tamar & Ms. E - From Ms. E's Kitchen
cleotv.us.description: Today it's recipes from Ms. E's kitchen. Yellow mustard fried chicken, big boy buttermilk biscuits and a mom & daughter fried cabbage cook off.

cleotv.us.title: Living by Design
cleotv.us.description: Brother-sister duo Jake and Jazz Smollett team up to transform living, work and play spaces of millennial families.

cleotv.us.title: Living by Design - Karina and Mike
cleotv.us.description: Karina & Mike want their living room/kitchen area to be a place to entertain. Jake builds a dining room table, while Jazz accessories with art, and gold accent pieces. On the menu is a delicious lamb stew and a chocolate chip brownie cookie.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Cheers
cleotv.us.description: When Nikki doesn't make the cheerleading squad, she and Kim rally the losers to form their own squad.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Hands Off, Grandma
cleotv.us.description: Nikki's recently widowed nana (guest star Isabel Sanford) tries to hook up with professor Oglevee (Dorien Wilson). J. Anthony Brown guest stars.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Blind Date Mistake
cleotv.us.description: Kim and Nikki (Countess Vaughn, Mo'Nique) are paired with a father and son (John Marshall Jones, Fred Thomas) on the TV show "Blind Date." Roger Lodge guest stars.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Field of Dreams
cleotv.us.description: Kim and Stevie try to live without the convenience of African-American inventions; Nikki honors her great uncle.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Who's Your Mama?
cleotv.us.description: A young woman claims that she and Kim (Countess Vaughn) were switched at birth. With Mo'Nique. Guest star: D.L. Hughley.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Mama, I Want to Sing
cleotv.us.description: The church choir begs for mercy when Nikki (Mo'Nique) replaces Kim (Countess Vaughn) as soloist. Guest star: Joseph C. Phillips, Fred Hammond and Kym E. Whitley.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Single Black Female
cleotv.us.description: Nikki's new friend (guest star Karen Bankhead) begins to imitate her in a creepy way; Kim (Countess Vaughn) gives up solid foods for two weeks. With Mo'Nique.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Et Tu Andell?
cleotv.us.description: Nikki's bothered by her ex-husband's relationship with Andell and professor Oglevee's romance with the school's new dean.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Moesha Meets Brandy
cleotv.us.description: Moesha sneaks backstage and meets singer Brandy after first being mistaken for the star. Brandy stars in a dual role.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Homecoming
cleotv.us.description: Moesha's (Brandy) visit to her grandmother (guest star Lynn Hamilton) causes tempers to flare in the family. With Sheryl Lee Ralph.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Hello, What's This?
cleotv.us.description: Frank and Dee (William Allen Young, Sheryl Lee Ralph) suspect Moesha (Brandy) when marijuana is discovered in the house.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Psyche Your Mind
cleotv.us.description: Moesha ditches a session when Frank and Dee enroll everyone in family counseling.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Teacher
cleotv.us.description: Moesha (Brandy) kisses her art teacher (guest star Jason W. George) then must deal with the emotional consequences.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - I Know What You Did in the 3rd Grade
cleotv.us.description: Everyone fears a bully (guest star Larry Wrentz) from Moesha's (Brandy) third-grade class will return to terrorize the neighborhood.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - A Terrible Thing Happened on My Tour of College
cleotv.us.description: When Moesha (Brandy) attends a party on a college campus, someone slips her the "date rape drug." Guest stars: Kellie Williams, George Wallace and Big Pun.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Birth Control
cleotv.us.description: When Moesha contemplates having sex with her boyfriend, Aaron, she takes steps to obtain birth control.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - A Class Act Christmas
cleotv.us.description: Moesha (Brandy) and her friends are held hostage in a mall by an unemployed man (guest star Henry G. Sanders) dressed as Santa Claus.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - The Crush
cleotv.us.description: Moesha's celebration over winning a writing contest is short-lived when it is revealed her story is bogus.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Barking up the Wrong Tree
cleotv.us.description: Moesha becomes concerned when Hakeem decides to take a job at Classy Man instead of going to college.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Life Imitating Art
cleotv.us.description: Moesha creates discord at her high school when she protests the lack of African-American representation in Antonio's mural.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Ohmigod, Fanatic
cleotv.us.description: MTV's "Fanatic" show selects Moesha (Brandy) to escort Kim (Countess Vaughn) to meet LeAnn Rimes (guest starring as herself).

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - The Rite Stuff
cleotv.us.description: Moesha (Brandy) boycotts the debutante ball when sponsors decline to allow a pregnant girl to participate.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - I Love Moesha
cleotv.us.description: Moesha finds solace in an "I Love Lucy" episode after Hakeem rejects her plea to become part of the band. (Sitcom) - 1999-03-02

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Home Is Where the Car Is
cleotv.us.description: Moesha is upset when someone else is named valedictorian, until she finds out he's an orphan living in his car. (Sitcom) - 1999-03-09

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Girls' Night In
cleotv.us.description: Moesha, Kim, Niecy and Hakeem (Brandy, Countess Vaughn, Shar Jackson, Lamont Bentley) reminisce about their years together when Moesha hosts a sleepover. (Sitcom) - 1999-03-30

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - It Takes Two
cleotv.us.description: Kim's mother (Mo'Nique) pursues her education by following her child to college; guest Loretta Devine. (Sitcom) - 1999-04-27

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Had to Be You
cleotv.us.description: Andell's college boyfriend (guest star Shemar Moore) makes a surprise visit in an attempt to rekindle old flames. Johnny Gill also guest stars. (Sitcom) - 1999-05-04

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - The Prom
cleotv.us.description: Moesha (Brandy Norwood) meets her dream man (guest star Johnnie Morton) at the prom, but he mysteriously leaves at midnight. (Sitcom) - 1999-05-11

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Independence Day
cleotv.us.description: All of Moesha's past boyfriends gather at her 18th birthday party. (Sitcom) - 1999-05-18

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - I Studied Twelve Years for This?
cleotv.us.description: Moesha's high-school graduation day is met with disappointment when her college application is rejected; her post-graduation plans change when she gets a job with VIBE magazine. (Sitcom) - 1999-05-25

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Moesha Meets Brandy
cleotv.us.description: Moesha sneaks backstage and meets singer Brandy after first being mistaken for the star. Brandy stars in a dual role. (Sitcom) - 1998-10-06

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Homecoming
cleotv.us.description: Moesha's (Brandy) visit to her grandmother (guest star Lynn Hamilton) causes tempers to flare in the family. With Sheryl Lee Ralph. (Sitcom) - 1998-10-13

fxm.us.title: Umma
fxm.us.description: A woman's quiet life on an American farm takes a terrifying turn when the remains of her estranged mother arrive from Korea. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Fathom
fxm.us.description: While touring abroad in Europe, beautiful American skydiver Fathom Harvill (Raquel Welch) gets wrapped up in international intrigue when Scottish spy Douglas Campbell (Ronald Fraser) recruits her to help him on a secret mission. Before long, Fathom realizes that no one around her, including the mysterious Peter Merriwether (Tony Franciosa), can easily be trusted, leading to various adventures that involve bullfighting, beaches and, of course, romance. (Action) - 1967

fxm.us.title: The Horror of It All
fxm.us.description: Yankee salesman Jack (Pat Boone) wants to marry Cynthia Marley (Erica Rogers), and they travel to her family's English estate to break the good news. Cynthia warns that the family is a bit odd, which proves to be an understatement. One relative is an ex-thespian who still believes he's in a play, another behaves like a vampire and a third is imprisoned in the cellar due to his violent tendencies. But things get really sinister when the Marleys start succumbing to violent fates, one by one. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: The Fly
fxm.us.description: When scientist Andre Delambre (Al Hedison) tests his matter transporter on himself, an errant housefly makes its way into the transportation chamber, and things go horribly wrong. As a result, Delambre's head and arm are now that of the insect. Slowly losing himself to the fly, Delambre turns to his wife, Helene (Patricia Owens), for help. But when tragedy strikes, Delambre's brother (Vincent Price) and Inspector Charas (Herbert Marshall) are forced to pick up the investigation. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1958

fxm.us.title: The Curse of the Fly
fxm.us.description: Scantily clad Patricia Stanley (Carole Gray) breaks out of a mental hospital and is picked up by passing motorist Martin Delambre (George Baker). The two do not reveal much about themselves to each other, but nevertheless decide to get married. At the Delambre family mansion, Patricia meets Martin's father, Henri (Brian Donlevy), an eccentric scientist. Snooping about the grounds, she discovers evidence of the family's strange experiments in teleportation and the grisly results thereof. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery, Drama) - 1965

fxm.us.title: The Day the Earth Stood Still
fxm.us.description: When a UFO lands in Washington, D.C., bearing a message for Earth's leaders, all of humanity stands still. Klaatu has come on behalf of alien life who have been watching Cold War-era nuclear proliferation on Earth. But it is Klaatu's soft-spoken robot Gort that presents a more immediate threat to onlookers. A single mother and her son teach the world about peace and tolerance in this moral fable, ousting the tanks and soldiers that greet the alien's arrival. (Science fiction) - 1951

fxm.us.title: The Day Mars Invaded Earth
fxm.us.description: A Cape Canaveral scientist finds Martians reducing people to ashes and taking their places. (Science fiction) - 1963

fxm.us.title: The Earth Dies Screaming
fxm.us.description: An astronaut (Willard Parker) returns from a test flight to find England overtaken by alien-controlled robots which turn corpses into zombies. (Science fiction) - 1964

fxm.us.title: Alien
fxm.us.description: In deep space, the crew of the commercial starship Nostromo is awakened from their cryo-sleep capsules halfway through their journey home to investigate a distress call from an alien vessel. The terror begins when the crew encounters a nest of eggs inside the alien ship. An organism from inside an egg leaps out and attaches itself to one of the crew, causing him to fall into a coma. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1979

fxm.us.title: Umma
fxm.us.description: A woman's quiet life on an American farm takes a terrifying turn when the remains of her estranged mother arrive from Korea. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Missing
fxm.us.description: When her mother disappears while on vacation in Colombia with her new boyfriend, June's search for answers is hindered by international red tape. Stuck thousands of miles away in Los Angeles, June creatively uses all the latest technology at her fingertips to try and find her before it's too late. However, as she digs ever deeper, her digital sleuthing soon raises more questions than answers. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2023

fxm.us.title: The Invitation
fxm.us.description: After the death of her mother and having no other known relatives, Evie takes a DNA test and discovers a long-lost cousin she never knew she had. Invited by her newfound family to a lavish wedding in the English countryside, Evie's at first seduced by the sexy aristocratic host. However, she's soon thrust into a nightmare of survival as she uncovers twisted secrets about her family history and the unsettling intentions behind their sinful generosity. (Horror, Thriller) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Missing
fxm.us.description: When her mother disappears in Colombia, June's search for answers is hindered by international red tape. Stuck thousands of miles away in Los Angeles, June uses all the latest technology at her fingertips to try and find her before it's too late. - 2023

fxm.us.title: The Invitation
fxm.us.description: Invited by her long-lost family to a lavish wedding in the English countryside, a woman is thrust into a nightmare of survival as she uncovers twisted secrets and the unsettling intentions behind their sinful generosity. - 2022

fxm.us.title: See How They Run
fxm.us.description: In the 1950s London, a world-weary inspector and an eager rookie constable take on a puzzling whodunit within the glamorously sordid world of underground theater, investigating a mysterious homicide at their own peril. - 2022

fxm.us.title: The Flight of the Phoenix
fxm.us.description: After being forced down in the desert, plane crash survivors race against time to rebuild their damaged aircraft. - 1965

fxm.us.title: Cleopatra
fxm.us.description: The queen of Egypt (Elizabeth Taylor) seduces Julius Caesar (Rex Harrison), but when he is killed, she uses Mark Antony (Richard Burton) as her new protector. - 1963

fxm.us.title: The 300 Spartans
fxm.us.description: Xerxes of Persia invades Greece with his army; Leonidas (Richard Egan) of Sparta fights back at Thermopylae. - 1962

fxm.us.title: Patton
fxm.us.description: Flamboyant Gen. George S. Patton (George C. Scott) receives accolades and censure as he fights World War II. - 1970

fxm.us.title: The Duke
fxm.us.description: In 1961, a 60-year-old taxi driver steals Goya's portrait of the Duke of Wellington from the National Gallery in London. He sends ransom notes saying that he will return the painting if the government invests more in care for the elderly. - 2020

fxm.us.title: The Last Full Measure
fxm.us.description: Airman William H. Pitsenbarger Jr. is awarded the Medal of Honor for his service and actions on the battlefield. (War, Drama) - 2019

fxm.us.title: The Rock
fxm.us.description: FBI chemical warfare expert Stanley Goodspeed (Nicolas Cage) is sent on an urgent mission with a former British spy, John Patrick Mason (Sean Connery), to stop Gen. Francis X. Hummel (Ed Harris) from launching chemical weapons on Alcatraz Island into San Francisco. Gen. Hummel demands $100 million in war reparations to be paid to the families of slain servicemen who died on covert operations. After their SEAL team is wiped out, Stanley and John deal with the soldiers on their own. (Action) - 1996

fxm.us.title: The Transporter
fxm.us.description: Ex-Special Forces operator Frank Martin (Jason Statham) lives what seems to be a quiet life along the French Mediterranean, hiring himself out as a mercenary transporter who moves goods - human or otherwise - from one place to another. No questions asked. Dangerous complications ensue when he is hired to kidnap the feisty daughter of a lethal Chinese crime lord who's smuggling his fellow countrymen into France. (Action, Thriller) - 2002

documentary+.us.description: A feel good deep dive into the high-stakes, eccentric world of card collecting, following buyers, sellers, card shop owners, graders, online streamers, auctioneers and more, who participate in the hobby in their own unique ways.

documentary+.us.title: Beauty Is Embarrassing
documentary+.us.description: Filmmaker Neil Berkeley documents the life and times of American artist Wayne White.

documentary+.us.title: Now! More! Yes!
documentary+.us.description: TW Hansen is a legally blind used car salesman, a landlord, and a film car coordinator living in Milwaukee. One of TW's tenants began following him with a camera after he drunkenly purchased an ambulance using his boss's money.

documentary+.us.title: Row of Life
documentary+.us.description: Angela Madsen, a Paralympian and Marine veteran, set out to be the first paraplegic and oldest woman to row the Pacific Ocean alone.

documentary+.us.title: Charm Circle
documentary+.us.description: The announcement of a polyamorous wedding threatens to sever what's left of a family bond.

documentary+.us.title: The Hermit of Treig
documentary+.us.description: After 40 years of solitude, a spirited hermit opens up to a filmmaker about his life as he tackles ill health, a declining memory, and uncertainty about whether he can continue his life in the wilderness he calls home.

documentary+.us.description: Filmmaker James Costa investigates the National School Lunch Program and childhood obesity, and shows what schools, parents, authors, doctors, politicians, celebrities, and chefs are doing to combat the problem.

documentary+.us.title: Lisa Dahl: Blessed by Grace
documentary+.us.description: The journey of Lisa Dahl, who turned personal tragedy into a culinary career.

documentary+.us.title: Hung up on a Dream: The Zombies Documentary
documentary+.us.description: British icons The Zombies reflect on 60 years of their musical path, from teenage friends to legends in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

documentary+.us.title: Your Attention Please
documentary+.us.description: Social media's impact on youth safety and mental health. Somewhat nostalgic for an idealized past, it highlights advocates like Kristin Bride fighting cyberbullying and innovators creating tools to help teens make better online choices.

documentary+.us.title: The Panama Papers
documentary+.us.description: Journalists risk their lives to break a story.

documentary+.us.title: Separated
documentary+.us.description: Based on NBC Political and National Correspondent Jacob Soboroff's book, Morris merges explosive interviews with whistleblowing officials and artful narrative vignettes tracing one migrant family's plight.

documentary+.us.title: Behind the Lines
documentary+.us.description: An army psychiatrist (Jonathan Pryce) treats a British poet (James Wilby), a young officer (Jonny Lee Miller) and others at a Scottish institution during World War I.

documentary+.us.title: Nostradamus: The Truth
documentary+.us.description: An examination of the astrologer's predictions reveals myths and events that surrounded the life of the legendary figure who lived 500 years ago.

documentary+.us.title: Haulout
documentary+.us.description: A man waits in his cabin on the desolate expanse of the Russian Arctic. He perseveres to observe a natural event that happens there every year, but ocean warming is taking its toll.

documentary+.us.title: The Last Ranger
documentary+.us.description: When young Litha is introduced to the magic of a game reserve by the last remaining ranger, they are ambushed by poachers. In the ensuing battle to save the rhinos, Litha discovers a terrible secret.

documentary+.us.title: After Antarctica
documentary+.us.description: Explorer Will Steger embarked on the first-ever coast-to-coast expedition across Antarctica in 1989. Now he returns to Antarctica 30 years later, witnessing the effects of climate change.

documentary+.us.title: Sacred Cod
documentary+.us.description: The story of how the oldest fishery in the United States has been driven to the edge of commercial extinction; includes interviews with fishermen, scientists, advocates, and federal officials.

documentary+.us.title: An Honest Liar

documentary+.us.title: Tracing the Divide
documentary+.us.description: Two lifelong friends find purpose as they cycle the Great Divide Mountain Bike Route from Canada to Mexico.

365blk.us.title: Ghosts of Mississippi
365blk.us.description: In this film based on actual events, black activist Medgar Evers is murdered in 1963, and much of the evidence points toward white supremacist Byron De La Beckwith. However, after two trials, De La Beckwith is acquitted twice by a jury of whites. Now, decades later in 1989, Evers' widow, Myrlie, thinks she has evidence to finally convict him. But no lawyer will touch the case except the young and brash Bobby DeLaughter. (Historical drama) - 1996

365blk.us.title: Moving
365blk.us.description: After civil engineer Arlo Pear (Richard Pryor) loses his job following a corporate merger, he must sell his house and move with his wife, Monica (Beverly Todd), and daughter, Casey (Stacey Dash), 2,000 miles from small-town New Jersey to Boise, Idaho. Unfortunately, the moving company -- led by slippery, fast-talking Perry (Robert LaSardo) -- has other ideas. When the movers go AWOL with the Pear family's belongings in the midst of the journey, Pear decides to take matters into his own hands. (Comedy) - 1988

365blk.us.title: Tyler Perry's Temptation: Confessions of a Marriage Counselor
365blk.us.description: Judith (Jurnee Smollett-Bell) has known her husband, Brice (Lance Gross), since they were in high school, but now their marriage is growing stale. Having just completed her graduate work in psychotherapy, she's eager to begin a career as a marriage counselor. She takes an internship at a matchmaking firm for millionaires and meets Harley (Robbie Jones), a charismatic client who makes no effort to hide his attraction to Judith. Judith succumbs to his charms, placing her marriage in jeopardy. (Drama, Romance, Thriller) - 2013

365blk.us.description: Ralph Angel tries to run the farm while the other siblings return to their everyday lives; Nova thinks that a friend's son has been wrongfully imprisoned and tries to help; Charley resumes managing her husband despite their strained relationship.

365blk.us.title: The Last Boy Scout
365blk.us.description: An ex-Secret Service agent (Bruce Willis) plays private eye with an ex-quarterback (Damon Wayans) on a case of sports gambling and murder. - 1991

365blk.us.title: Money Talks
365blk.us.description: Reporter James (Charlie Sheen) brings petty crook Franklin (Chris Tucker) to justice, but as Franklin is being taken to jail, he is unwittingly drawn into a violent prison break. The police pursue Franklin, mistakenly thinking he killed several officers, so the fugitive turns to James for help. Figuring he has stumbled upon the story of a lifetime, the journalist agrees to prove that Franklin is innocent. Unfortunately, things don't go smoothly, and both men find themselves on the run. (Action, Comedy) - 1997

365blk.us.title: War
365blk.us.description: After his partner and family are killed, FBI agent Jack Crawford (Jason Statham) becomes obsessed with revenge on an assassin named Rogue (Jet Li). Rogue's return sparks a violent war between rival Asian mobsters Chang (John Lone) and Shiro (Ryo Ishibashi), while the ultimate showdown between Crawford and Rogue reveals the truth. (Action, Thriller) - 2007

5starmax.us.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
5starmax.us.description: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra. (Science fiction) - 1964

5starmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
5starmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

5starmax.us.title: A History of Violence
5starmax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Batman
5starmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Batman Returns
5starmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Batman Forever
5starmax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Batman & Robin
5starmax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

5starmax.us.title: Repo Men
5starmax.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
5starmax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug.
