bbcamerica.us.description: Briscoe and Curtis investigate the death of a promising mathematician who was involved in a turbulent relationship with a college professor.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Refuge
bbcamerica.us.description: Briscoe and Curtis become entangled in the Russian mafia while investigating two murders with a speechless child as the only witness.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Refuge
bbcamerica.us.description: McCoy must link jailed Russian mob suspects to money laundering and murder before their release on technicalities.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Gunshow
bbcamerica.us.description: McCoy aims to prosecute both the suspect and the gun manufacturer after a shooting spree in Central Park kills 15 people.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Killerz
bbcamerica.us.description: The detectives suspect a 10-year-old girl is responsible for the death of a boy at a construction site.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - DNR
bbcamerica.us.description: A judge maintains her husband's innocence after a botched murder attempt leaves her mortally wounded.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Merger
bbcamerica.us.description: A scandal involving two wealthy families threatens McCoy and Carmichael's chances of a conviction in the murder of a drug-addicted girl of 15.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Justice
bbcamerica.us.description: McCoy opposes his former colleague, Jamie Ross, in the murder of another attorney for which a man may be wrongly convicted.

bbcamerica.us.title: Wild Spring - New Life
bbcamerica.us.description: Springtime bears new beginnings, where pairs come together to form a family and much of the animal kingdom introduces its young to the world.

bbcamerica.us.title: Wild Spring - Predation
bbcamerica.us.description: The season of spring sees every corner of the world stir, but with new life comes opportunity for the hunter and scavenger.

bbcamerica.us.title: Wild Spring - Adaptation
bbcamerica.us.description: Witness some of the animal kingdom's adaptations to the ever-changing conditions of spring, from shedding winter coats to mass migrations.

bbcamerica.us.title: Wild Spring - Survival
bbcamerica.us.description: Across the globe, spring brings a burst of activity, but with it come new challenges; in the animal kingdom, there is one goal: survive.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth III - Human
bbcamerica.us.description: Questions about how animals adapt to the worlds built by the planet's most invasive species, humans; a search for loot to steal with macaques in Bali; hunting for easy eats with bears in Lake Tahoe; whale poo help fish populations bounce back.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth III - Forests
bbcamerica.us.description: Exploring forests as hidden worlds where the lives of animals are entwined, including temperate forests home to whistling wild dogs, as well as rainforests where ninja treehoppers fight off assassin bugs.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth - Deserts
bbcamerica.us.description: An examination of the often-not-seen life that inhabits the deserts of Earth.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth III - Ocean
bbcamerica.us.description: Sir David Attenborough reveals new animal behaviors in the ocean.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth III - Coasts
bbcamerica.us.description: Sir David Attenborough explores the dangerous frontiers created by the world's coasts, where animals fight for survival amid constant change; there are some unexpected residents on Namibia's Skeleton Coast.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth III - Extremes
bbcamerica.us.description: Animals fight to survive extremes, from tundra to deserts, mountain summits to deep underground.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth - Freshwater
bbcamerica.us.description: The descent of rivers from their mountain sources to the sea.

bbcamerica.us.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
bbcamerica.us.description: Sean Anderson partners with his mom's husband on a mission to find his grandfather, who is thought to be missing on a mythical island. - 2012

bbcamerica.us.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
bbcamerica.us.description: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2017

bbcearth.us.title: Chimp Family Fortunes
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Clan leader Freud, his brother Frodo, and popular female Gremlin are all members of a wild chimpanzee clan who live in a tropical jungle in Tanzania.

bbcearth.us.title: Chimp Family Fortunes
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 While gentle female Gremlin struggles to raise her young twins, their father Frodo hides from the other male chimps who are out to get him.

bbcearth.us.title: Chimp Family Fortunes
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Frodo makes a dramatic appearance while the clan are out hunting, and cocky young Sheldon causes a stir among the males.

bbcearth.us.title: Chimp Family Fortunes
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E04 The lost young twins run into a band of marauding baboons and are terrified. Will they ever see their mum Gremlin again?

bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Sir David Attenborough looks at some amazing quirks of evolution; he encounters two examples where nature has tinkered with the aging process.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : A Curious Twist
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E04 David Attenborough looks at the tusk of the narwhal and the spiral shells found on snails and ammonites.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Seeing The Pattern
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E05 Beautifully patterned or brightly colored animals attract the attention of collectors.

bbcearth.us.description: S02 E02 Rhinos and hedgehogs protect themselves with body armor in the form of thick skin.

bbcearth.us.description: S02 E03 Animals adapt to life in the dark; owl eyes are too large to move within their sockets; the giant squid has the largest eyes in the animal kingdom.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Imposters
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E04 Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on amazing animals; he looks at cuckoos and the way the death's-head hawkmoth steals honey.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Bad Reputations
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E05 Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on nature's most amazing animals; he takes a closer look at the vampire bat.

bbcearth.us.description: S02 E06 How naturalists find out that some eels are electric is revealed.

bbcearth.us.description: S02 E07 Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on the wood frog, which freezes solid; he looks at how the emperor penguin breeds.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Spinners and Weavers
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E08 Nature produces two unique mechanisms of natural construction; weaving in birds and silk fascinate scientists.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Strange Parents
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E09 David Attenborough shines the spotlight on female hyenas; he examines why male seahorses give birth.

bbcearth.us.description: The disappearance of some animals each year puzzled early naturalists; the question arises whether swallows hibernate in mud or underwater and the sudden appearance of butterflies each spring was also a mystery.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Impossible Feats
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E01 David Attenborough examines how fleas jump; he tracks the true speed of a cheetah.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Minds
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E02 David Attenborough examines orangutans and crows, two unusual animals that use tools.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Expandable Bodies
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E03 David Attenborough examines creatures that have fascinated people for centuries; he looks at the expandable bodies of anacondas and camels.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Feeders
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E04 A look at some species with unusual styles of consuming food, including the gigantic blue whales and the flamboyant flamingos.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Cures
bbcearth.us.description: Humans are not alone in using medicines against injuries and infection and some animals protect themselves with natural remedies in extraordinary ways.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Remarkable Regeneration
bbcearth.us.description: A look at the animals who can regenerate entire parts of their bodies.

bbcearth.us.title: Seasonal Wonderlands
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 New England New England is the stage for the most incredible color change on earth, when the vivid greens of summer give way to the golds and reds of autumn.

bbcearth.us.title: Seasonal Wonderlands
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Svalbard Svalbard in the Arctic spends many months of the year in complete darkness, an unrelenting frozen winter with temperatures down to 40 below Celsius.

bbcearth.us.title: Seasonal Wonderlands
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Okavango The Okavango Delta is a lush wetland of islands and lagoons in the middle of the vast, featureless Kalahari Desert.

bbcearth.us.title: Big Bear Diary
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Follow the trials and tribulations of North America's bears as they struggle to survive in an increasingly hostile world.

bbcearth.us.title: Big Bear Diary
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 The conflict between black bear mothers Jeannie and Katie continue as Jeannie besieges Katie's two cubs in a tree; Brown bear mother Blondie and her three cubs make the most of carrion washed up by the sea.

bbcearth.us.title: Big Bear Diary
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Brown bear mum Blondie and her cubs were last seen fleeing from a pack of wolves. Have they survived? Both the black and polar bear families have trouble with marauding males.

bbcearth.us.title: Snow Wolf Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: Meet the Wolfpack In an attempt to improve the understanding of wild wolves, Gordon Buchanan travels to the remote Canadian Arctic in search of wolves that have never seen humans before.

bbcearth.us.title: Snow Wolf Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Survival of the Pups Gordon Buchanan uses his skills as a wildlife cameraman to gain the trust of a white wolf family; as spring turns to summer, he becomes accepted by the pack, including mother Luna and her three newborn pups.

bbcearth.us.title: Snow Wolf Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Big Bad Wolves Gordon Buchanan reunites with his white wolf family as they try to raise their pups and prepare for winter; he walks with wolves as they hunt lemmings, muskox and hares and encounter a rival pack.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Iceland: A Wild Life A look at Iceland through the eyes of the animals and people that have made it their home.

bbcearth.us.title: The Bear Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Spring Gordon Buchanan must overcome his own fear, black bears have a dangerous reputation and attack more people than any other bear in the world, but once he meets Lily, a tolerant bear, mother of Hope, Gordon feels heartbroken.

bbcearth.us.title: The Bear Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Summer Summer arrives and Gordon finds out that Tiny the bear cub has been abandoned by her mother.

bbcearth.us.title: The Bear Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Autumn It is autumn and Gordon finds out that Hope is back with her mother.

bbcearth.us.title: How Nature Works
bbcearth.us.description: The Magic Forest A lynx depends on a caterpillar to survive, and the forest depends on salmon.

bbcearth.us.title: Wildlife on One
bbcearth.us.description: S16 E06 Oasis Desert life and migrating birds converge at oases in the Sahara.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: White Shark, Red Triangle One in ten shark attacks worldwide take place in California's Red Triangle; discover how sharks are being drawn to the area by the large seal population.

bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Nisha cooks some Malaysian mussels and ginger biscuit lamb raan.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E10 Nisha cooks chicken and apricot biryani and fish finger sandwiches.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Suffolk and Naples Rick celebrates the abundance of seafood and the rich, colorful sauces of Naples.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 India and Cornwall Rick catches turbot off the Cornish coast and cooks it with cider and cream.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Spain and Britain Rick's off to Galicia in Spain to sample some rare shellfish.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 India and America A spicy shark vindaloo and the making of an authentic dhal with lentils.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Australia and Italy Seafood king Rick travels to Queensland, Australia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 America and Cornwall Chesapeake Bay in the U.S., cooking traditional oyster dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Thailand and Cornwall Rick goes to Hua Hin in Thailand, where he spends time in local markets talking to locals about various types of food; in Cornwall, he fries fish and jazzes it up with red curry and steamed jasmine rice.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 America and Yorkshire Rick visits America, Naples and the UK in Whitby, with good old English fish and chips in the final episode.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Sweet and Sour Nigel Slater shows us how to prepare five different sweet and sour dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Fish and Meat Nigel continues to explore successful food marriages in the kitchen.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Spicy and Cool Nigel Slater shows us how to mix spicy flavors with something cooling.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Soft and Crisp Nigel Slater continues his exploration of brilliant culinary combinations.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Sugar and Spice Nigel shows a classic cinnamon, ginger and plum cake and demonstrates the unexpected such as sticky ribs and a spicy lentil stew with caramelized onions.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Born and Bred Nigel transforms everyday suppers, including a dish of baked mushrooms and chestnuts and a home-grown pud of blackberry and fig pie.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Kolkata and Chennai Rick explores Bengal and Tamil Nadu, the regions that began Britain's love affair with curry; Rick enjoys the prominence of fish and seafood in their dishes, flavored with mustard in Kolkata and tamarind in Chennai.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Mumbai and Pondicherry Rick explores Mumbai in search of the bombil, the fish that immortalized Bombay Duck; enjoying Parsee hospitality.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Lucknow and Punjab Rick Stein arrives in the cultural city of Lucknow, India; it is reputed to be the curry capital of India.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rajasthan and Himachal Pradesh Rick Stein visits the royal state of Rajasthan, a land of kings, hilltop forts and palaces, where the local population are serious meat-eaters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Madurai and Lucknow Rick Stein discovers a five-star hotel in Madurai employing local housewives for genuine home-cooked dishes and enjoys Chettinad Chicken, a dish inspired by spices brought back from both the east and the west by traveling merchants.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Nigella introduces her love of Italian food through a spectacular yet simple Sicilian pasta with tomatoes, garlic and almonds and a mid-week family feast of tagliata.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Nigella Lawson shares the secrets of her Italian roast chicken, served alongside a saffron orzotto; Nigella prepares coffee ice cream for dessert, inspired by the ice cream parlors of Florence; a chocolate olive oil cake provides an extra treat.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Episode 3 Pork loin stuffed with Parma ham and oregano, served alongside her speedy mock mash and lazy person's vignarola.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Liquorice pudding; Sardinian sun-dried and toasted couscous; butterflied leg of lamb; baby aubergines with oregano and roasted red onion.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Nigella starts with her take on a light and sunny yogurt pot cake; she recruits her niece and nephew to make a shortcut sausage meatball supper; Nigella prepares squid and prawns with marjoram and chili; a tiramisu ends the evening.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Episode 6 Lamb chops with mint; chilli and golden potatoes; ruby red plum and amoretti crumble; farro risotto with mushrooms.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rick Stein searches for herring along the northeast coast of Scotland.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Pilchards, bream, ormer and cockles with laverbread.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Sweet brown shrimp; flounder; fresh salmon; oysters; scallops.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Silver eels; edible seaweed; langoustines; pollan.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Cockles and samphire; pink shrimps; Cromer crabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Wild smoked salmon; sea trout; sea moss pudding.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Fresh cod; smoked kippers; prepares halibut with cucumber; salmon en croute.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Cambodia and Vietnam Rick enjoys freshly caught swimmer crabs cooked with green peppercorns.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Vietnam and Thailand Rick Stein travels down the Mekong River to Vietnam.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Thailand and Malaysia Rick travels to Phuket to learn the art of hot and sour tom yum goong.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: Card Sharks
buzzr.us.description: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800. (Game show) - 1978-04-24

cartoonnetwork.us.description: The Crystal Gems are a team of magical beings who are the self-appointed guardians of the universe. Half-human, half-Gem hero Steven is the "little brother" of the group. The goofball is learning to save the world using the magical powers that come from his bellybutton and he goes on magical adventures with the rest of the Crystal Gems, even though he's not as powerful -- or smart -- as fellow group members Garnet, Amethyst and Pearl. Despite his shortcomings, Steven usually finds a surprising way to save the day. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy, Action) - 2013-11-04

cartoonnetwork.us.title: Teen Titans Go!
cartoonnetwork.us.description: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. What he doesn't know is that his talent is genetic, and that he is the descendant of a long line of Masters of Disguise, all of whom have inherited the secret family gift known as Energico. Initially, Pistachio is a klutz, but little by little, he learns to harness his inherited power, and sallies forth to utilize Energico to its fullest. (Comedy, Movie) - 2002-08-02

cinevault.us.title: Apple of My Eye
cinevault.us.description: A tragic accident causes a young equestrian (Avery Arendes) to lose her sight and her ability to connect with anyone or anything, until a miniature horse named Apple is trained to be her companion and surrogate eyes. (Drama, Movie) - 2017-01-10

cinevault.us.title: Ice Castles
cinevault.us.description: A figure skater searches for inner strength after a tragic accident jeopardizes her future. (Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2010-02-09

cinevault.us.title: Places in the Heart
cinevault.us.description: In 1935 rural Texas, recently widowed Edna Spalding struggles to survive with two small children, a farm to run and very little money in the bank -- not to mention a deadly tornado and the unwelcome presence of the Ku Klux Klan. Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret; a blind boarder, Mr. Will; and a would-be thief, Moze, who decides to stick around to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton. (Drama, Movie) - 1984-09-21

cinevault.us.title: Home Invasion
cinevault.us.description: A mother (Veronica Hamel) and daughter (Bonnie Root) try to outwit robbers holding them and three friends captive. (Movie, Thriller) - 1997-01-13

cinevault.us.title: Dirty
cinevault.us.description: Armando Sancho is a former Los Angeles gang member who has transitioned into law enforcement. Sancho, however, who is surrounded by corruption, finds that life as a police officer is just as morally bankrupt as life as a gangster. After being implicated in the shooting of an innocent man himself, Sancho is then pressured to testify against his loose-cannon friend and partner, Salim Adel, who has a history of abusing citizens. (Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2005-11-09

cinevault.us.title: Against All Odds
cinevault.us.description: Having been cut from his professional football team, down-and-out athlete Terry Brogan (Jeff Bridges) is in desperate need of money. Crooked nightclub owner and bookie Jake Wise (James Woods) offers Terry a hefty sum to go to Mexico and find his girlfriend, Jessie Wyler (Rachel Ward). Terry cannot turn the offer down. When Terry locates Jessie, the two fall in love. Terry reports that he failed to find her; but Jake sends someone else. Terry and Jessie's love must endure unexpected twists. (Action, Crime drama, Movie, Romance) - 1984-03-02

cinevault.us.title: Eat Pray Love
cinevault.us.description: Liz Gilbert (Julia Roberts) thought she had everything she wanted in life: a home, a husband and a successful career. Now newly divorced and facing a turning point, she finds that she is confused about what is important to her. Daring to step out of her comfort zone, Liz embarks on a quest of self-discovery that takes her to Italy, India and Bali. (Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2010-08-13

cinevault.us.title: Julie & Julia
cinevault.us.description: Frustrated with a soul-killing job, New Yorker Julie Powell embarks on a daring project: she vows to prepare all 524 recipes in Julia Child's landmark cookbook, "Mastering the Art of French Cooking." Intertwined with Julie's story is the true tale of how Julia Child herself conquered French cuisine with passion, fearlessness, and plenty of butter. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 2009-08-07

cinevault.us.title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
cinevault.us.description: Following a childhood tragedy, Dewey Cox (John C. Reilly) follows a long and winding road to music stardom. Dewey perseveres through changing musical styles, an addiction to nearly every drug known and bouts of uncontrollable rage, until finally, he wins the heart, but not necessarily the body, of his loyal backup singer, Darlene (Jenna Fischer). (Comedy, Movie, Musical comedy) - 2007

cinevault.us.title: She's Out of Control
cinevault.us.description: A Los Angeles radio-station manager's (Tony Danza) girlfriend (Catherine Hicks) shows his teenage daughter (Ami Dolenz) how to be sexy. (Comedy, Movie) - 1989-04-14

cinevault.us.title: The River Murders
cinevault.us.description: A homicide detective investigating a series of murders becomes the prime suspect when the FBI uncovers his close ties to all the victims. (Movie, Thriller) - 2011-07-01

cinevault.us.title: Red Water
cinevault.us.description: Former oil rig worker John Sanders (Lou Diamond Phillips) became a Louisiana fishing captain after a tragic accident ended his career. In need of money, he agrees to help his ex-wife, Kelli (Kristy Swanson), whose company is having trouble extracting oil upriver. Meanwhile, thugs working for a Jamaican gangster head to the same bayou searching for $3 million buried underwater. Both the scientists and the criminals are menaced by a man-eating shark that can survive in fresh water. (Movie, Thriller) - 2003-08-17

cinevault.us.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
cinevault.us.description: Bill Johnson leads a group of scientists into the jungles of Borneo. They are searching for the mythical black orchid, which can supposedly grant eternal life. Unfortunately, massive anacondas have been feeding on the orchids for years. When their boat goes over a waterfall, the scientists land right in the middle of the snakes' home. (Action, Adventure, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2004-08-27

cinevault.us.title: Maximum Risk
cinevault.us.description: French police officer Alain Moreau makes an astonishing discovery: Mikhail, a man who died recently in a breakneck car chase, is the twin brother he never knew. Alain then uncovers a web of family secrets that lead him to New York City, where his brother was involved with the Russian Mafia. Teaming up with Mikhail's lover, Alex Minetti, Alain must now assume his twin's identity and go undercover to avenge Mikhail's death. (Action, Movie) - 1996

cinevault.us.title: Bad Country
cinevault.us.description: After arresting a contract killer, a Louisiana detective tries to convince him to become an informant in an attempt to bring down the South's most powerful criminal organization. (Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2014

cinevault.us.title: Takers
cinevault.us.description: Gordon Jennings (Idris Elba) and his friends enjoy a luxurious lifestyle funded by bank robberies, and they avoid capture by sticking to a strict set of rules. As they celebrate the latest job, a former associate arrives with a daring plan to rob an armored car. The lure of so much cash is too tempting to resist but, unbeknown to Gordon's men, this heist puts them on a collision course with Russian mobsters and a detective (Matt Dillon) who will do anything to capture them. (Action, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-08-27

cinevault.us.title: The Tourist
cinevault.us.description: During an impromptu trip to Europe to mend a broken heart, math teacher Frank Tupelo (Johnny Depp) finds himself in an extraordinary situation when an alluring stranger, Elise (Angelina Jolie), places herself in his path. Their seemingly innocent flirtation turns into a dangerous game of cat and mouse while various people, who all think that Frank is Elise's thieving paramour, Alexander Pearce, try to capture the pair. (Action, Movie, Romance, Thriller) - 2010-12-09

cinevault.us.title: 28 Days
cinevault.us.description: The story of Gwen Cummings (Sandra Bullock), a successful New York writer living in the fast lane and everyone's favorite party girl -- until she gets drunk with boyfriend Jasper (Dominic West), borrows her sister's (Elizabeth Perkins) wedding limo and earns herself a stay in court-ordered rehab. divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Harmony Dubose vs. Tyrone Dubose
divorcecourt.us.description: Harmony is ready to end her four-year marriage after one of Tyrone's family members sent her a sex tape Tyrone made with her friend; he says it isn't him in the sex tape and argues that Harmony has already cheated on him with his female co-worker. (Reality, Law) - 2021-10-13

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Lauren Home vs. Miguel Avila
divorcecourt.us.description: Lauren says she can't trust Miguel because of his gambling addiction -- he pawned her computer and TVs and stole items out of their home to feed his addiction; he says the house was robbed, and he wants help for his addiction. (Reality, Law) - 2021-10-14

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Franklin Smith vs. Keaonna Cane
divorcecourt.us.description: Franklin says Keaonna's bisexuality is complicating their relationship, and he wants her to stop cheating; the final straw was when she made gumbo for him after an argument, knowing he's allergic to seafood. (Reality, Law) - 2021-10-15

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Alma Leiva vs. Marcus Hill
divorcecourt.us.description: Alma says that when she moved in with her boyfriend, Marcus, his female roommate was not happy about them dating, leading her to believe that there was more to their relationship than he had told her. (Reality, Law) - 2021-10-18

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - MarQuis Thompkins vs. Kimberly Talton
divorcecourt.us.description: MarQuis says he feels like a boy toy for his older girlfriend, Kimberly, who will gladly spend his money but won't move the relationship forward to marriage; she says he over-sexualizes everything, and all he wants to do is stay home.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Deanna Gaston vs. Carlos Ashley
divorcecourt.us.description: Deanna is ready to walk away from her two-year relationship with Carlos due to his immaturity and not making her a priority; she says he has yet to introduce her to any of his friends; he asks her to be patient.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Stephanie Mann vs. Johnathon Mann
divorcecourt.us.description: Stephanie says she and Johnathon are supposed to be working on their marriage during their yearlong separation, but he is acting single; he says she is jealous and can't control her emotions.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Alton Sharpe vs. Diamond Sharpe
divorcecourt.us.description: Alton says he met his wife, Diamond, on social media and fears that how he got her is how he'll lose her if they don't get help; Diamond says that posting sexy photos is not cheating, and that Alton made advances toward her friend.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Kimberly Steele vs. Quinton Steele
divorcecourt.us.description: Kimberly says she found photos that were sent to Quinton of naked women he was talking to; Quinton says he's been nothing but loyal to Kimberly.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Aleyda Gonzales vs. Kasey Bone
divorcecourt.us.description: Aleyda wants Kasey to get a better paying job so they can move out of his mother's house; Kasey says he wants Aleyda to be patient and give him a chance to improve their situation.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Mark Dibello vs. Marina Larina
divorcecourt.us.description: Marina is on temporary visa with 60 days to get married, but she fears Mark is getting cold feet; Mark feels he's being used, and he hates his fiancée's job and her social media presence.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ashley McCullough vs. David Mason
divorcecourt.us.description: Ashley says her trust and respect for David has been eroded by multiple cheating incidents; David says he's growing increasingly frustrated by the lack of affection and sex in their relationship.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Moriah Watson vs. Dante Watson
divorcecourt.us.description: Moriah says Dante has fathered two children with two different women during their relationship; Dante admits to cheating in the past but wants to move forward and says he's focused on his marriage.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Jessica Duax vs. Sean Nordsell
divorcecourt.us.description: Jessica wants to get married to Sean but doesn't feel like her feelings are being reciprocated; Sean says he's been engaged before, and it didn't work out; he wants Jessica to have patience to move their relationship to the next level.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Melanie Hogan vs. Terrell Howard
divorcecourt.us.description: Melanie says Terrell promised her the world, but his actions are showing the opposite; Terrell says he's disappointed Melanie doesn't want to get married.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Rachel Sharp vs. Fabian Jaime
divorcecourt.us.description: Rachel says the pandemic has turned her boyfriend into a lazy, porn-addicted, and jealous person.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Portress Tucker vs. Chelsea Harris
divorcecourt.us.description: Portress says her fiancé, Chelsea, is a liar and a cheater, and she's ready to end the relationship if she doesn't change; Chelsea says she caught Portress at home with another woman.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Nicole Borden vs. Antonio Borden
divorcecourt.us.description: Nicole says Antonio is a womanizer who has fathered children outside their marriage; Antonio admits to his mistakes in the past but refuses to sign divorce papers.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Carmen Ramsey vs. Cornelius \"Reese\" Ramsey
divorcecourt.us.description: Carmen says her husband, Reese, cheated on her and is responsible for putting their family in financial jeopardy after sinking their money into a food truck; he blames her for his infidelity because she doesn't show him enough affection.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Mark Stankevicius vs. Grace Baine
divorcecourt.us.description: Mark wants to save his relationship with Grace, but her daughter, Chandler, is driving a wedge between them due to her drinking problem.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Elizabeth \"Libby\" Blanton vs. Douglas \"Drew\" Ater
divorcecourt.us.description: Libby says she is unsure of her engagement to Drew, because he's called off the wedding twice.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Tomeka McWilliams vs. Marc Holladay
divorcecourt.us.description: Tomeka says she spent more than $20,000 on Marc to support his music career, only for him to disappear for two months after their engagement; he says she is punishing him for her past failed relationships.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Tomeka McWilliams vs. Marc Holladay
divorcecourt.us.description: Tomeka says her boyfriend, Marc, is a cheater who is using her for her money; he blames her past relationships.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Timothy Horvath vs. Jessica Barr
divorcecourt.us.description: Timothy doesn't trust his fiancée Jessica's relationships with her male friends; she says he is insecure and overzealous about catching her cheating, and she has no privacy due to him spying on her and checking her phone every opportunity he gets.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Domenique King vs. Sylvester King
divorcecourt.us.description: Dominique says she can no longer stay in her marriage and watch Sylvester kill himself with his drinking; she wants him to get help for his drinking problem, but he says he enjoys drinking and wants her to understand that he's never going to change.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Jennifer Heeder vs. Rigel Pawlak
divorcecourt.us.description: Jennifer says she walked in on Rigel having a threesome with two women; he admits to his past transgressions and says that lifestyle is behind him.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Raheem Gaines vs. Steven Bellamy
divorcecourt.us.description: Raheem says Steven can't control his emotions, especially when he's drinking, and lashes out in anger; Steven says his boyfriend is the reason for all their problems, because he is overly controlling and betrayed his trust, possibly beyond repair.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Amber Ward vs. Jasmine Walker
divorcecourt.us.description: Amber says Jasmine took out a $10,000 loan to fuel her gambling addiction and may be cheating with a secret benefactor who helped her pay it off; Jasmine argues that Amber belittles her by constantly hanging money over her head.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Darielle Crowe vs. Yourick Jones
divorcecourt.us.description: Darielle says Yourick has a problem keeping a job, and she is done with her fiancé enjoying the fruits of her labor; he argues that she is over-controlling and will dictate when he can use the cars, which both belong to her.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Benita Santillanes vs. Jorge Diaz
divorcecourt.us.description: Benita says fiancé Jorge has canceled 20 different dates she has set to get married; he says he is more focused on buying them a house rather than an overpriced wedding, and he's committed to her but doesn't want to be pressured into marriage.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Qolett Richardson-Jackson vs. Michael "Demo" Williams
divorcecourt.us.description: Qolett says fiancé Demo allowed a woman to twerk on his Jeep at an event and has seen videos on social media of him getting too close to his female "friends"; he says she is just jealous of the attention his Jeep gets, and she tracks his every move.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Kelly Leblanc vs. Latrice Jenkins
divorcecourt.us.description: After proposing two years ago, Kelly got a better-paying job and moved out of state, and Latrice was supposed to follow, but Kelly believes another woman prevented her from moving.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - "Latta" Black-Myrick vs. Joie Black-Myrick
divorcecourt.us.description: Latta says Joie has threatened to leave her for another woman during arguments they've had; Joie says Latta is inconsiderate, never at home and denies her sex.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Mitzi Howard vs. Juan Mcafee
divorcecourt.us.description: Mitzi says Juan lets his family members convince him that she is promiscuous; he says he found sexually explicit text messages from one of her exes on her phone and is ready to end things.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Amy Jones vs. Ricardo Jones
divorcecourt.us.description: Amy says her husband, Ricardo, fathered four children outside their relationship, and she wants a divorce; Ricardo says the stress of co-parenting Amy's four children from a previous relationship led to the downfall of their marriage.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Danielle Richardson vs. Logan James
divorcecourt.us.description: Logan says he doesn't know if his and Danielle's relationship will last if she doesn't conform to a polyamorous lifestyle; she says she met the other woman and wants him to cut things off with her.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Pashion Smart vs. Joshua Smart
divorcecourt.us.description: Pashion says husband Joshua's constant disrespect and perusing of women on social media have become too much for her to handle.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Troy Hall vs. Victoria Bradley
divorcecourt.us.description: Troy says he's had enough of his girlfriend's accusations of cheating and if things don't change, he's done; Victoria says Troy's multiple baby mamas could be the downfall of their relationship.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Donna Gafford vs. Jeffery Gray
divorcecourt.us.description: Donna says she's ready to call off her engagement to Jeffery because he'd rather spend time with his military friends than with her; Jeffery says Donna is overreacting and calling off the wedding is the wrong decision.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Sarah Iqbal vs. Klay Redd Fleming
divorcecourt.us.description: Sarah says her boyfriend's entertainment lifestyle is driving a wedge between them; Klay says as a singer-songwriter, he works with female clients, but he's not cheating.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - LaPreshia Lewis vs. Darnell Bonner
divorcecourt.us.description: LaPreshia says she didn't know how bad Darnell's gambling habit was until she moved in with him, and she is sick of him pawning their valuables; he realizes he's made some mistakes financially due to his gambling but wants to save his relationship.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Tony Garcia vs. Kimberly Rosen
divorcecourt.us.description: Tony says he is unsure if he wants to move forward with the wedding, because Kimberly did a bait-and-switch and is not the same woman he proposed to -- she has started neglecting her household duties and always orders out instead of cooking.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Darla Thompson vs. Dylan Flowers
divorcecourt.us.description: Darla says her fiancé, Dylan, has anger issues and his nonstop use of profanity and name-calling is too much; he says she goes out of her way to trigger him and nags him to the point where he verbally releases his frustrations on her.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Alessia Barnes vs. Dontavius Ellis
divorcecourt.us.description: Alessia says her boyfriend, Dontavius, leads her to believe they are getting married, but she keeps catching him with other women, and he has even moved in with one; he says she constantly accuses him of cheating when he is just working.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Renata Copeland vs. Blake Smith
divorcecourt.us.description: Renata says her boyfriend, Blake, stays out all night and posts photos on social media with other women, and she has even found condoms in his car; he counters that she spends hundreds of dollars shopping online every week.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Theresa Graves-Jordan vs. Kevin Teagues
divorcecourt.us.description: Theresa says her boyfriend, Kevin, is living a double life, and she's had enough of him ghosting her on the weekends; he wants to get married but wants his freedom, too, saying his biggest issue with her is that she tries to monopolize his free time.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Steve Quinn vs. Shirley Quinn
divorcecourt.us.description: Steven says his wife's verbal abuse, infidelity and constant criticism of his stockpiling supplies for an apocalypse has left him with no choice but to file for divorce.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Outrageous Cheaters
divorcecourt.us.description: Cheaters make some pretty outrageous excuses when it comes to their infidelity; Judge Faith takes a look back at some memorable moments when the litigants cheated on their significant others.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Patricia Nesbit vs. John Nesbit Jr.
divorcecourt.us.description: Patricia says she's had enough of her husband, John, disrespecting their marriage by sleeping with other women and his indecisiveness on whether he wants to be in a committed relationship.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Anne Pearson vs. Charles Pearson
divorcecourt.us.description: Anne suspects another woman is in the picture, which has led her to spy on Charles to catch him cheating, saying he sneaks out of the house while she is sleeping; he says she used to enjoy going out until they got married.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Niquetta Hood vs. Tyrone Johnson
divorcecourt.us.description: Niquetta tells the blatant lies from her boyfriend, Tyrone, show he's not committed to her or their family; he says he's constantly being accused of cheating and he's sick of it, so he accuses her, and asks for a DNA test for their son.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Phylicia "Riddick" vs. Jeremiah Koellner
divorcecourt.us.description: Phylicia says her fiancé, Jeremiah, is possessive, tracks her every move, tries to tell her how to dress, and got her fired from her job as an exotic dancer due to his jealousy.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Tasha Boomer vs. Bryant Boomer
divorcecourt.us.description: Tasha is ready to end her marriage to Bryant because of his lack of motivation to find a stable job and contribute to the bills, and she is sick of him running to his family to bail him out; he says she is jealous.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Nova Francis vs. Dameon Francis
divorcecourt.us.description: Nova says her husband, Dameon, is a womanizer, and she has even walked in on him with another woman; he argues that she is way too controlling.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Crystal Sanders vs. Dywan Sanders
divorcecourt.us.description: Crystal says her new husband, Dywan, lied about his financial status and is addicted to watching sports, which leaves no time for them; he says he paid his debts, and she is using past mistakes to dictate their future.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Sharkyla Truth vs. Afaria \"AJ\" Duke
divorcecourt.us.description: Sharkyla is ready to call off the wedding if her fiancé, AJ, can't stay monogamous; he admits to cheating but says he is a changed man, and the problem is Sharkyla, because she can't get past his infidelity.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Zakelia Scott vs. Michael Randle
divorcecourt.us.description: Zakelia says her boyfriend, Michael, spends all of his money on frivolous things and doesn't save any for their future; he says he is a hip-hop artist and needs the clothes and sneakers to look the part. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-25

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Jaclyn Ivaniuc vs. Spencer Ruizzo
divorcecourt.us.description: Jaclyn says that during the pandemic, boyfriend Spencer started binge-eating and overspending; he says he can spend his money the way he wants to and is sick of her negative comments about his weight. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-26

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Leticia Riddle vs. Jay White
divorcecourt.us.description: Leticia believes her fiancé, Jay, is cheating with one of his exes, who lives in a home he owns; Leticia is a singer and Jay says she behaves inappropriately when she is rubbing up against other men during her shows. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-27

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Lakeysla \"Keisha\" Williams vs. Brian \"Champ\" Harmon
divorcecourt.us.description: Keisha says Champ's excessive flirting is ruining the trust in their marriage; he says that, as a rapper and television producer, it pays to have a big personality, and she needs to control her jealousy. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-28

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ieisha Shingles vs. Quan Porter
divorcecourt.us.description: Ieisha says boyfriend Quan is a serial cheater with an anger problem leading him to destroy her property on many occasions; he says she destroyed his Lakers memorabilia during an argument. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-31

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Valerie Bossett vs. Toya Gonzales
divorcecourt.us.description: After being married less than a year, Valerie says she wants a divorce from her wife, Toya, who, she says, cheated with one of her exes; Toya says she wants to save her marriage, but Valerie holds the past against her and refuses to move forward. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-01

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Jasmine Allen vs. Chance Shelton
divorcecourt.us.description: Jasmine says boyfriend Chance spends too much time at the studio and may have gotten another woman pregnant; she has invested $20,000 in his music business but hasn't seen a return; he accuses her of spending time with another man. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-02

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Brandon Benson vs. Nicole Lara
divorcecourt.us.description: Brandon says his girlfriend, Nicole, is obsessed with going viral and isn't focused on her career goals; he says they are just too different, and it's best they go their separate ways. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-03

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Brandon Benson vs. Nicole Lara
divorcecourt.us.description: Nicole says she desperately wants to save her relationship with Brandon, but her goal is to go viral with her social media videos to make money. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-04

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Theresa Connors vs. Mark Haynes
divorcecourt.us.description: Theresa says her fiancé, Mark, is a sex and porn addict who spent half of their wedding budget on his addiction; he says he wants to save his relationship, but he believes she is overreacting and he doesn't have a problem. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-07

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Demetria George vs. Tyrone Faison
divorcecourt.us.description: Demetria says Tyrone wants to be in control of every aspect of her career as a stand-up comic, including who she talks to and where she performs; Tyrone says that, as the man, he wants to be respected. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-08

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - David Irvin vs. Hillary Barlow
divorcecourt.us.description: David says Hillary, his girlfriend, has a history of cheating and lying to him; she admits she was caught in some compromising situations but says she is not a cheater and that his mother is the root of all their problems. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-09

filmriseaction.us.title: Code Name Banshee
filmriseaction.us.description: Caleb, a former government assassin in hiding, resurfaces when his protégé, the equally deadly killer known as Banshee, discovers a bounty has been placed on Caleb's head. Now, they must put the past behind them and join together one last time to fight off the secret CIA-backed killers who threaten to destroy them. (Action, Drama) - 2022

filmriseaction.us.title: Direct Contact
filmriseaction.us.description: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given the chance for freedom if he is able to rescue a kidnapped American woman. (Action) - 2009

filmriseaction.us.title: Abduction
filmriseaction.us.description: A man steps out of a fountain in a park in Ho Chi Minh City with no memory of who he is. He wanders the city trying to piece together his past while being pursued by mysterious figures. (Action) - 2019

filmriseaction.us.title: Cover-Up
filmriseaction.us.description: An American journalist (Dolph Lundgren) gets too close to the truth about alleged terrorist attacks in Tel Aviv. (Action) - 1991

filmriseaction.us.title: Castle Falls
filmriseaction.us.description: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive. (Action, Thriller) - 2021

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Arlington Road
filmriseaction.us.description: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure) - 1999

filmriseaction.us.title: JCVD
filmriseaction.us.description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery. (Comedy, Crime drama, Action) - 2008

filmriseaction.us.title: Operator
filmriseaction.us.description: When the daughter of a dispatcher and a cop is kidnapped, they are forced to follow the kidnapper's rules and have to choose to save their daughter or the city. (Action, Drama, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: The Contract
filmriseaction.us.description: A man (John Cusack) and his young son (Jamie Anderson) encounter an assassin (Morgan Freeman) while hiking in a forest. - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: Cops and convicts join forces to defend a barren police station from a vengeance-seeking street gang. - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: Dillinger and Capone
filmriseaction.us.description: Dillinger's (Martin Sheen) reported 1934 death gives him a new life, but Chicago mobster Capone (F. Murray Abraham) wants him to pull one more heist. - 1995

filmriseaction.us.title: Guns of Redemption
filmriseaction.us.description: Searching for redemption, a mysterious gunslinger with a violent past tries to save a young woman from vicious men who run a traveling brothel. - 2025

filmriseaction.us.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
filmriseaction.us.description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town. - 2023

filmriseaction.us.title: Blitz
filmriseaction.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. - 2011

filmriseaction.us.title: The 51st State
filmriseaction.us.description: A chemist (Samuel L. Jackson) who produces illegal drugs travels to Liverpool, England, to negotiate one last deal before he retires. - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Survivor
filmriseaction.us.description: Framed for a terrorist bombing, a foreign service officer (Milla Jovovich) must dodge a top assassin (Pierce Brosnan), while racing against time to thwart a deadly plot. - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell
filmriseaction.us.description: Kyle LeBlanc winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife. He is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt warden, the facility holds brutal fights between inmates. - 2003

filmriseaction.us.title: Stolen
filmriseaction.us.description: A former thief (Nicolas Cage) has just 12 hours to come up with $10 million after his former partner (Josh Lucas) kidnaps his daughter and locks her in a cab. - 2012

filmriseaction.us.title: If... Dog... Rabbit
filmriseaction.us.description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother. - 1998

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The 51st State
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American. (Action, Comedy) - 2001

filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity. (Action) - 2003

retroplex.us.description: An aging matador (Anthony Quinn) faces fear as he loves a rich American (Maureen O'Hara) and guides his son (Manuel Rojas) in the bullring. (Romance) - 1955

retroplex.us.title: Pit Pony
retroplex.us.description: A horse's companionship helps a boy overcome his fears and work in a Nova Scotia coal mine to support his family. (Drama) - 1997

retroplex.us.title: West of the Divide
retroplex.us.description: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Sagebrush Trail
retroplex.us.description: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose. (Western) - 1933

retroplex.us.title: Ambush Trail
retroplex.us.description: Curley Thompson (Bob Steele) clashes with Hatch Bolton (I. Stanford Jolley), who is buying out small ranches in order to sell to a large grain combine. Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Yankee Fakir
retroplex.us.description: Yankee Davis (Douglas Fowley) and his partner, professor Newton (Ransom Sherman), are a pair of traveling hucksters on their way to a town in Arizona. Soon after they arrive, Yankee falls for a local girl, Mary Mason (Joan Woodbury). Mary's lawman father turns up dead, and Yankee is sure the man was murdered, but the death is ruled an accident. Believing something's off, Yankee has an elderly associate, Shaggy (Clem Bevans), pose as a rich man and offer a reward for clues about the killing. (Mystery) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
retroplex.us.description: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang. (Action, Western) - 1967

retroplex.us.title: Boss
retroplex.us.description: Two ex-slave bounty hunters (Fred Williamson, D'Urville Martin) take care of business in a lawless Wild West town. (Western) - 1975

retroplex.us.title: Pit Pony
retroplex.us.description: A horse's companionship helps a boy overcome his fears and work in a Nova Scotia coal mine to support his family. (Drama) - 1997

retroplex.us.title: Vengeance Valley
retroplex.us.description: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. 700407.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
700407.description: Monty explores the extraordinary scenery of the west coast of America. He begins his journey in Arizona where he learns about cacti and marvels at the sight of them in the desert and in private gardens where they have replaced traditional plants and lawns.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty sows rocket, harvests chillies and tomatoes, and demonstrates how to take semi-ripe cuttings. Frances Tophill meets a head gardener in south London who's started gardening sustainably.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Adam Frost is in his garden, bringing viewers up to date on how it has been developing, as well as giving advice on growing hydrangeas. Toby Buckland shares his tips on dealing with damaged shrubs, tree pruning and transplanting perennials.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don and Nigel make the most of the season and prepare for the winter ahead. Meanwhile Carol Klein is in Surrey looking at wild and cultivated heathers.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty meets two sets of gardeners who have unimaginable ambitions for their outdoor spaces. In Essex Denise has never ventured beyond the decking area behind her house. Meanwhile in Ipswich, a father and daughter plan to build a terraced allotment.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty comes to the rescue of two couples in need of help transforming their rubble filled back gardens into havens of peace and tranquillity. They are in serious need of help and advice but can Monty set them on the right track?

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Two gardeners, each living on their own, are hoping Monty can help them. In Blackpool, Alex dreams of turning her boring back yard into a magical enchanted forest. Also in Bristol, Ross has taken on a very over-grown allotment.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team are in Daresbury in Chester with downsizers, Karen and Alan. The couple have a small, wedge-shaped garden with so little in it that the only thing to look at is the fences, but those fences don't even provide privacy from the neighbours.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team visit Bernadette, a dedicated social worker for troubled adults who has always put the needs of others before her own. Having recently turned sixty, Bernadette finally wants some 'me time': a new garden could give her a well-deserved reward.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team have an unusual challenge: to turn a long, pointed front garden into a water-saving, wildlife-friendly space. Mum Laura wants a place to encourage the bugs and creepy-crawlies that young son William loves.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: In Salford, the team meet Nicole, who grew up in Germany. She wants to recreate her family's German 'kleine' garden, a traditional community space divided into fruit, veg and lawn.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty and the team celebrate the wonder of trees and explore the vital role they play in gardens and the wider landscape. Zoe Ball joins Toby Buckland on a visit to a tree project in North London.

700407.title: Gardeners' World

classica.us.title: Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin
classica.us.description: Für Freunde und Musiker war und ist die Schweizer Klaviervirtuosin Clara Haskil eine Interpretin, die wie keine andere Maßstäbe gesetzt hat. Anhand von Klaviereinspielungen, Briefen und Interviews zeigt der Film die Musikerin in neuem Licht. (Special, Documentary, Biography, Art) - 2017-08-27

classica.us.title: Chopin - Fantaisie in f-Moll, op. 49
classica.us.description: Der italienische Pianist Andrea Molteni führt Frédéric Chopins Fantaisie in f-Moll, Op. 49, auf. Molteni begann im Alter von sechs Jahren mit dem Klavierspiel. Er absolvierte das Conservatorio di Musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como mit Auszeichnung. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-05-10

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 2, 'Auferstehung'
classica.us.description: Orchester und Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino unter der Leitung von Myung-Whun Chung spielen Mahlers Auferstehungssymphonie. Solistinnen sind Christiane Karg, Sopran, und Claudia Huckle, Alt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-16

classica.us.title: Heavenly Voices - Farinellis Vermächtnis
classica.us.description: Als "Kastraten" werden männliche Sänger bezeichnet, die mit glockenklarer Stimme Tonhöhen des Soprans erreichen können, weil man sie noch vor dem Stimmbruch kastriert. Die Dokumentation beschäftigt sich mit dem Aufstieg bekannter Kastraten in der Geschichte und den Umständen, die ihre Karriere möglich machten. Außerdem sprechen die zwei Kontratenoren Max Emanuel Cencic und Philippe Jaroussky über die Musikentwicklung im Barock. (Documentary, Music) - 2012

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi leitet das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester in einer Aufführung von Beethovens 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, Op. 55. Neben der fantastischen "Eroica" werden auch Strawinskis Psalmensinfonie und Strauss' "Don Juan" interpretiert. (Special, Entertainment, Music, Concert) - 2020-12-10

classica.us.title: Schumann - Davidsbündlertanze, Op. 6
classica.us.description: Der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwartz spielt die Davidsbündlertänze Op. 6. Sie sind eine Gruppe von achtzehn Klavierstücken, die im Jahr 1837 komponiert wurden. Sie sind nach Schumanns Musikgesellschaft, den Davidsbündlern, benannt. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2023-11-21

classica.us.title: Bach - 3. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs sechs Brandenburgische Konzerte gehören zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 3 in G-Dur. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-11

classica.us.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 9
classica.us.description: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leitet das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino bei einer Aufführung von Gustav Mahlers Symphonie Nr. 9 in D-Dur. Diese Symphonie wurde in den Jahren 1908-1909 geschrieben und war die letzte, die Mahler vollendete. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-23

classica.us.title: Mahler, Symphonie Nr. 6 a-Moll
classica.us.description: Gustav Mahler (1860-1911): Symphonie Nr. 6 a-Moll. Paavo Järvi dirigiert das hr-Sinfonieorchester. Aufgenommen beim Rheingau Musik Festival im Kloster Eberbach. Der österreichische Komponist und Dirigent Gustav Mahler führte die traditionsreiche Gattung der Symphonie ins 20. Jahrhundert. Seine Werke sind heute Bestandteil des Standardrepertoires jedes großen Orchesters. (Special, Music, Event) - 2015-08-26

classica.us.title: Händel auf Schloss Chambord
classica.us.description: Hervé Niquet und das Ensemble Concert Spirituel spielen "Te Deum" von Marc-Antoine Charpentier. (Special, Documentary, Music, Classical) - 2016-09-09

classica.us.title: Schumann - 2. Klaviersonate in g-Moll, op. 22
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz Schumanns Klaviersonate Nr. 2 in g-Moll, Op. 22. Es beginnt mit einem energischen ersten Satz, gefolgt von einem wunderschönen, langsamen Andantino nach Schumanns Lied "Im Herbste". (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-01-09

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - 3. Sinfonie, op. 78
classica.us.description: Das Philharmonische Orchester Rotterdam spielte unter der Leitung von Conrad van Alphen am 20. Oktober 2018 in Rotterdam Saint-Saëns' 3. Sinfonie. Sie trägt den Beinamen "Orgelsinfonie", da dieses Instrument im zweiten und vierten Satz zu hören ist. (Special, Event, Music) - 2019-04-06

classica.us.title: Fantasymphony: One Concert to Rule them all
classica.us.description: Ein beeindruckendes Konzerterlebnis, das mit einer Mischung aus spektakulären Sound- und Lichteffekten eine ganz besondere Atmosphäre schafft. Mit der Unterstützung eines Chors werden verschiedene Filmmusikstücke komplett neu vertont. (Music, Concert) - 2020

classica.us.title: Danielpour - Elegies
classica.us.description: Hartmut Haenchen leitet das Orchester der Philharmonie zuidnederland in einem Konzert von Richard Danielpours "Elegies". Solisten sind Marina Prudenskaya und Thomas Oliemans. Die Aufnahme entstand 2019 im Muziekgebouw Eindhoven in den Niederlanden. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-04-04

classica.us.title: Die drei Leben der Clara Schumann
classica.us.description: Die Biografie von Clara Schumann ist legendenumwoben: Ihre strenge Kindheit, ihr außergewöhnliches Talent als Pianistin, ihre frühe Liebe zum Komponisten Robert Schumann und die Erziehung von sieben Kindern bieten Material für Mythen und Klischees. (Special, Documentary) - 2019-09-15

classica.us.title: Welser-Möst dirigiert Farrenc & Mussorgsky/Ravel
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchester mit einem Programm, das im März 2023 im Severance Music Center in Cleveland aufgezeichnet wurde. Auf dem Programm sind Louise Farrencs Sinfonie Nr. 3, Ravels Klavierkonzert in G-Dur mit Víkingur. (Special) - 2026-05-23

classica.us.title: Donizetti - Lucia di Lammermoor
classica.us.description: Die italienische Dirigentin Speranza Scappucci leitet die Philharmonia Zürich und den Chor des Opernhauses Zürich bei einer Aufführung von Gaetano Donizettis tragischer Oper "Lucia di Lammermoor" aus dem Jahr 1835. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-06-23

classica.us.title: Le Grand Orgue in Concert
classica.us.description: Olivier Latry, der Titularorganist der großen Orgel der Pariser Kathedrale Notre-Dame, verzaubert mit einer meisterhaften Performance an der historischen Orgel der Kathedrale. Das Konzert entstand 2015 unter der Regie von Noëlle Louisor. (Special, Music, Documentary) - 2019-05-07

classica.us.title: Hans van Manen: Moving to Music
classica.us.description: Reflexionen von Freunden und Kollegen, die Details der Choreographie von Hans van Manen enthüllen.

classica.us.title: Tschaikowski - 2. Sinfonie, op. 17
classica.us.description: Das London Symphony Orchestra spielt unter der Leitung des Amerikaners Michael Tilson Thomas Tschaikowskys Symphonie Nr. 2 in c-Moll. Die Symphonie trägt auch den Spitznamen "Kleinrussische", da ukrainische Volkslieder mit einflossen.

classica.us.title: Schumann: Humoreske, Op. 20
classica.us.description: In der Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz die Humoreske in B-Dur, Op. 20. Schumann komponierte das Werk im Jahr 1839 und widmete es Julie von Webenau. Der Titel des Werks bezieht sich auf die ältere Bedeutung von Humor als emotionaler Zustand.
