outlaw.us.title: Cole Younger, Gunfighter
outlaw.us.description: In the days after the Civil War, Kit Caswell (James Best) rebels against an increasingly corrupt police force in Texas. After escaping from police custody, Kit happens upon Cole Younger (Frank Lovejoy), a killer who explains the circumstances behind his actions. The outcasts strike up a friendship and return to town to see Kit's girlfriend. Once back, Kit discovers his father has been killed. Attempting to find those responsible, he's forced to flee after he's accused of murder. (Western) - 1958

outlaw.us.title: The Cowboys
outlaw.us.description: A grizzled veteran rancher, Wil Andersen (John Wayne) is almost ready to embark on a big cattle drive when his crew abruptly quits to join in a gold rush. Left with no alternative, Anderson enlists the help of a group of local schoolboys. Training the youngsters to be cowboys, Andersen manages to get the drive underway, but their long journey is placed in jeopardy when the devious bandit Long Hair (Bruce Dern) sets his sights on stealing the herd. (Western) - 1972

outlaw.us.title: The Train Robbers
outlaw.us.description: A proud widow hires a Civil War veteran to help recover the gold her late husband stole from Wells Fargo. (Western) - 1973

outlaw.us.title: Wild Stallion
outlaw.us.description: Raised by a cowboy (Edgar Buchanan) at a cavalry fort, an orphan becomes an officer (Ben Johnson) and looks for his long-lost horse. (Western) - 1952

outlaw.us.title: The Big Trees
outlaw.us.description: Corrupt Wisconsin lumberman Jim Fallon travels to Northern California at the dawn of the 20th century in order to gain control of a tract of redwood forest. Fallon's underhanded tactics stir resentment from everyone, including settler Elder Bixby; his beautiful daughter, Alicia; Fallon's fair-minded employee, Yukon Burn; and his right-hand man, Frenchy LeCroix -- and his cheating ways create unlikely bedfellows. (Western) - 1952

outlaw.us.title: The Hanging Tree
outlaw.us.description: Joseph "Doc" Frail (Gary Cooper) is a doctor with a past he's trying to outrun. While in Montana, he comes across a mining camp with a hanging tree and rescues a man named Rune (Ben Piazza) from the noose. With Rune as his servant, Frail decides to settle down, and he takes over as town doctor. He meets Elizabeth (Maria Schell), who is suffering from shock, and the two soon fall in love. But when Elizabeth is attacked, Frail's attempt to help her land them both in trouble. (Western) - 1959

outlaw.us.title: Springfield Rifle
outlaw.us.description: A Union major (Gary Cooper) with a wife (Phyllis Thaxter) and son goes undercover as a traitor to stop a Confederate raider (David Brian). - 1952

outtvproud.us.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2
outtvproud.us.description: Chainsaw-wielding maniac Leatherface (Bill Johnson) is up to his cannibalistic ways once again, along with the rest of his twisted clan, including the equally disturbed Chop-Top (Bill Moseley). This time, the masked killer has set his sights on pretty disc jockey Vanita Stretch Brock (Caroline Williams), who teams up with Texas lawman Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) to battle the psychopath and his family deep within their lair, a macabre abandoned amusement park. (Horror, Dark comedy) - 1986

outtvproud.us.title: D.O.A.: Dead or Alive
outtvproud.us.description: Four beautiful rivals at an invitation-only martial-arts tournament join forces against a sinister threat. Princess Kasumi (Devon Aoki) is an aristocratic warrior trained by martial-arts masters. Tina Armstrong (Jaime Pressly) is a wrestling superstar. Helena Douglas (Sarah Carter) is an athlete with a tragic past. Christie Allen (Holly Valance) earns her keep as a thief and an assassin-for-hire. (Action, Science fiction, Martial arts) - 2006

outtvproud.us.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
outtvproud.us.description: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed. (Science fiction) - 1978

outtvproud.us.title: Masters of the Universe
outtvproud.us.description: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon. (Fantasy) - 1987

outtvproud.us.title: Frankenstein
outtvproud.us.description: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist. (Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2004

outtvproud.us.title: Lizzie
outtvproud.us.description: In 1892 Lizzie Borden lives a quiet life in Massachusetts under the strict rules established by her father. Lizzie finds a kindred spirit in the live-in maid, Bridget, and friendship soon blossoms into a secret romance. But tension mounts in the Borden household, leading to a violent breaking point. (Thriller, Historical drama) - 2018

outtvproud.us.title: Blindsided

outtvproud.us.title: Backtrack
outtvproud.us.description: While fixing a flat tire, artist Anne Benton (Jodie Foster) sees a mob killing. She reports the murder to the local police, but they are unable to protect her from Mafia don Lino Avoca (Vincent Price), who orders hitman Milo (Dennis Hopper) to track her down and kill her. Anne changes her identity, moves to Seattle and builds a new life, while Milo, preparing for his mission, becomes increasingly obsessed with her. When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1989

thestandupchannel.us.title: Bob Saget: Zero to Sixty
thestandupchannel.us.description: Bob Saget declares himself to be the last TV father viewers can trust in his hour of entertaining stories, riffing with the audience, words of wisdom and new original comedy songs.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Danny Martinello: Starting Sober
thestandupchannel.us.description: Danny Martinello's debut special dedicated to those who had his back when he decided to put down the bottle.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Shaw: Manly Girly Man
thestandupchannel.us.description: Jeff Shaw entertains with his stimulating satire.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jesus Trejo: Stay at Home Son
thestandupchannel.us.description: Mexican-American comic Jesus Trejo explores his upbringing as an only child to immigrant parents; he recalls learning many of life's lessons in the most unconventional ways, all the while feeling the need to meet his parents' high expectations.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Kevin Smith: Silent But Deadly Extended Edition
thestandupchannel.us.description: Kevin Smith is anything but quiet in this new comedy special that was recorded an hour before his heart attack in February; before he nearly died backstage, onstage he discusses his marriage, his kid and his work (or lack thereof).

thestandupchannel.us.title: Leanne Morgan: So Yummy
thestandupchannel.us.description: Leanne Morgan gives an honest look at suburban life and the challenges of keeping her husband happy while juggling kids, dogs, and cheerleading camp.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Whitney Cummings: Money Shot
thestandupchannel.us.description: One of the funniest comics on television.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham's 250th Red, White, And Blue Birthday Special
thestandupchannel.us.description: Jeff Dunham celebrates America's 250th birthday with Walter, Peanut, Bubba J and Achmed in a star-spangled comedy event full of patriotic mischief, where his crew may not understand the history, but they absolutely understand the sentiment.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
thestandupchannel.us.description: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
thestandupchannel.us.description: In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs his most popular characters, including Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, and Bubba J, while discussing topics such as Hollywood, politics and romance.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
thestandupchannel.us.description: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos
thestandupchannel.us.description: A live concert performance that leans heavily on four favorite characters; cranky old man Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, the mischievous purple whatsit and Peanut.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Tom Papa: Freaked Out
thestandupchannel.us.description: Papa's comedy special touches on subjects such as the hazards of churches, make-up, loose change, old age, Chinese grocery stores, raising women and magical gnomes.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Lavell Crawford: The Comedy Vaccine (Extended Edition)
thestandupchannel.us.description: The comic performs his fifth stand-up comedy special in Tempe, Ariz., focusing on COVID-19 and offering his views on mask culture, fatherhood and why 2020 was the best year to fart in public.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Tommy Davidson: Takin' It to D.C.
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic Tommy Davidson at George Washington University in Washington, D.C.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Lavell Crawford: New Look Same Funny! (Extended Edition)
thestandupchannel.us.description: Lavell Crawford, with a new look and new outlook on life, hosts a new standup special.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jim Gaffigan: Quality Time
thestandupchannel.us.description: The comic uses his signature everyman humor to deal with the unthinkable; filmed at the State Theatre in Minneapolis.

travel.us.title: The Alaska Triangle - The Mysteries of Ketchikan and The Wendigo
travel.us.description: An underwater alien base may be located off the coast of a quiet Alaskan town; a cannibalistic creature preys upon those brave enough to venture into the Alaska Triangle. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Alaska Triangle - Mysterious Forces and Haunted Roads
travel.us.description: Ominous sounds from the skies could be a sign of the impending apocalypse; drivers are spooked by phantom headlights and ghostly hitchhikers along Alaska's haunted highways. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: 2026 Silver Eagle is here & it is a once-in-a-lifetime coin!
travel.us.description: Join your hosts Kevin Cash & Cory Cady as we discuss the 250th Anniversary of America with the official "America 250" logo on a Silver American Eagle label; we are locking in orders for this iconic release, but coins are limited! Don't miss out! (Paid Program)

travel.us.title: Overwhelmed with IRS Debt? Keys to Resolving Tax Debt
travel.us.description: See how one company is changing people's lives by helping them put their tax problems to rest. (Paid Program)

travel.us.title: Inogen Portable Oxygen - No More Tanks!
travel.us.description: Regain independence and enjoy greater mobility with the compact design and long-lasting battery of portable oxygen. (Paid Program, Health)

travel.us.title: Under Eye Bags? SOLUTION!
travel.us.description: Plexaderm helps reduce Under Eye Bags, Dark Circles, and Wrinkles in just 10 minutes! (Paid Program, Lifestyle)

travel.us.title: Unexplained: Caught on Camera - The Demonic Scratch House
travel.us.description: A face-off with an angry demon who scratches a Canadian couple exploring a haunted mansion; meeting a pushy pub poltergeist in the UK; seeing strange footage captured by an Australian man who swears that a ghost has been walking his beloved pooch. (Performing Arts, Reality TV)

travel.us.title: Unexplained: Caught on Camera - The Secret Séance in Peru
travel.us.description: An Urban explorer is terrified by a graveyard séance in Peru; in Scarborough, a woman is shocked by a poltergeist throwing noodles in her store; it's all unexplained and caught on camera. (Performing Arts, Reality TV)

travel.us.title: Destination Fear - Old Bourbon Distillery
travel.us.description: Exploring one of America's oldest bourbon distilleries. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Destination Fear - Randolph County Infirmary
travel.us.description: The team returns to Indiana to explore an abandoned facility that has haunted Tanner's nightmares for the past five years; he has only now mustered up the courage to confront who -- or what -- terrorized him during their first investigation. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Destination Fear - Joliet Prison
travel.us.description: It's sweet revenge for Chelsea when she takes the team to Chicago's terrifying Joliet Prison; terrible things happen once they separate inside its walls. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Destination Fear - Rolling Hills Asylum
travel.us.description: Tanner confronts his greatest fear when the team explores an upstate New York asylum that is said to be haunted by the spirit of a 7-foot-tall man. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Destination Fear - Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum
travel.us.description: The team heads to West Virginia to explore an asylum in America; Dakota has doubts about their ability to combat the bloodthirsty souls lurking in the shadows of the cursed property, but Tanner believes they are up for the challenge! (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Destination Fear - Old Idaho Penitentiary
travel.us.description: After many nights of torment by the paranormal, Alex finally gets his chance to pick a haunted location for the team to investigate; he has planned the most terrifying experiment for Dakota yet at an infamous Idaho prison. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Destination Fear - Old Hospital On College Hill
travel.us.description: The team may shatter as it arrives at a deserted West Virginia hospital known for its brutal deaths and grisly amputations. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Dead Files - Driven to Kill
travel.us.description: Steve and Amy travel to Toledo, Ohio, where a family faces a daily onslaught of aggressive paranormal activity; Steve uncovers a grisly string of murders committed near the property, while Amy encounters a twisted spirit intent on harming the living. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Dead Files - Town of the Dead
travel.us.description: Steve and Amy travel to Upper Darby, Pa., where a woman claims the dead are attacking her three children, and with the activity getting more dangerous by the day, she's worried someone is going to die. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Dead Files - The Gateway
travel.us.description: Steve and Amy travel to Wakefield, Mass., where a young mother fears a gateway to the afterlife has brought unwanted guests into her grandmother's home; with the activity getting worse by the day, it's only a matter of time before someone is hurt. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Dead Files - Puppet Master
travel.us.description: Steve and Amy travel to Indianapolis where a couple claims dark forces are wreaking havoc on their lives; they fear the house intends to kill them to prevent them from providing a safe and loving home to their two young granddaughters. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Dead Files - Dark Soul
travel.us.description: Steve and Amy are called to Pataskala, Ohio, to investigate claims of paranormal activity terrorizing a grandmother and her family; all hell has broken loose inside the home, and everyone believes they are in serious danger. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Dead Files - Last Call
travel.us.description: Steve and Amy travel to Palatka, Fla., to investigate violent paranormal activity at a downtown bar; the owners claim all hell broke loose when they began renovations, and they fear the family business is cursed. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Dead Files - Detox
travel.us.description: A woman claims paranormal activity has spiked ever since she got sober; she fears if the evil spirits lurking inside her home can't be stopped, she will fall down a dark path of no return. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Dead Files - The Deadly Picture Show
travel.us.description: Steve and Amy investigate the Silent Movie Theater in Los Angeles, where sinister spirits have instilled fear among the staff. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Dead Files - Death's Gallery
travel.us.description: An evil presence lays siege on a museum and its employees in California. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

universalmovies.us.title: The Eagle
universalmovies.us.description: Accompanied by his slave, a Roman soldier (Channing Tatum) heads to Scotland's Highlands to retrieve the long-lost Ninth Legion's emblem, and in doing so, to restore his father's honor.

universalmovies.us.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
universalmovies.us.description: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

universalmovies.us.title: Darkman
universalmovies.us.description: An acid-scarred scientist (Liam Neeson) uses 99-minute masks to be with his girlfriend (Frances McDormand) and trap gangsters.

universalmovies.us.title: Tremors
universalmovies.us.description: Four big worms with multiple tongues dig high-speed around people (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) in the middle of nowhere.

universalmovies.us.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
universalmovies.us.description: The Mexican government hires two handymen (Fred Ward, Michael Gross) to battle huge man-eating worms plaguing an oil field.

universalmovies.us.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
universalmovies.us.description: Mutated graboids return to feast on the residents of Perfection, threatening its new status as a tourist attraction.

universalmovies.us.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
universalmovies.us.description: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

universalmovies.us.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
universalmovies.us.description: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

universalmovies.us.title: Child's Play 2
universalmovies.us.description: While Andy's mother is admitted to a psychiatric hospital, the young boy is placed in foster care, and Chucky, determined to claim Andy's soul, is not far behind.

universalmovies.us.title: Child's Play 3
universalmovies.us.description: Chucky returns for revenge against Andy, the young boy who defeated him, and now a teenager living in a military academy.

universalmovies.us.title: Bride of Chucky
universalmovies.us.description: Animated by a vicious killer's spirit, a battered doll and its mate seek help from neighbors (Katherine Heigl, Nick Stabile) to regain human form.

universalmovies.us.title: Firestarter
universalmovies.us.description: Quasifederal agents hunt a man (David Keith), who can bend minds, and his daughter (Drew Barrymore), who can start fires by staring.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E01 Strange Places Exploring the Lake Michigan Triangle and many other wild and weird places, including a doll-filled island with a dark past, deadly gas-filled explosive lakes, caves that harbor deadly viruses and a haunted place in the United States.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E09 What Lies Beneath A look at tales of strange things below Earth's surface, including sea beasts, hidden cities, and tunnels carved by giant sloths.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E04 Weird Weapons A million bats with tiny bombs strapped to their chests, inflatable tanks, robot assassins, bazooka Vespas, and war dolphins; these weapons, and others, pushed the boundaries of "possible" in the weirdest ways ever.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
unxplainedzone.us.description: S02 E01 It Came From Above Wondering about bizarre things that have fallen from the sky; from meteorites to seafood, and even bathtubs, these are some unbelievable stories of what comes from above.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
unxplainedzone.us.description: S02 E12 Extraordinary Journeys From a dog's space voyage, to a harrowing story of Arctic survival, to various trips through time; journeys so extraordinary that they are truly unbelievable.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
unxplainedzone.us.description: S02 E13 Peculiar Punishments One-of-a-kind crimes are often met with one-of-a-kind punishments; like a pig whose bloody rampage lands itself in the courtroom, or a music enthusiast whose wall-rattling beats subject them to hours of classical symphonies.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
unxplainedzone.us.description: S02 E17 Astonishing Escapes We've heard the tales of successful prison breaks, but these aren't your average escapes; from a man who frees himself all thanks to a stone fruit, to a Soviet pilot that evades capture by stealing the enemy's plane.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 90s, a gang based in the U.S. Virgin Islands began smuggling thousands of kilos of cocaine into mainland America. Police and federal agents target the gang, but its leader remains a mystery. In an investigation spanning from Georgia to South America, local police, the DEA, U.S. Customs and the FBI work together to take down this dangerous drug gang.

400000091.title: Los archivos del FBI (Doblado)
400000091.description: El primero de octubre de 1993, un extraño secuestró a Polly Klaas de doce años durante una piyamada en su casa. El FBI de inmediato entró en el caso. Los agentes reunieron fibras de su habitación y descubrieron, a través del uso de fuentes de luz láser, la huella de una palma en la cama de Polly, previamente invisible al ojo humano. Después de una extensa investigación de dos meses, el FBI arrestó a Richard Allen Davis. La impresión de la palma y las fibras coincidieron y Davis fue condenado por secuestro y asesinato.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway. Although he proclaimed his innocence the FBI lab experts were able to link tool marks found on the frame with tools found in Gwaltney's home. Through the match of hairs and fibers and a unique test for detecting and identifying sperm, Gwaltney was placed at the scene of the crime.

400000091.title: Los archivos del FBI (Doblado)
400000091.description: El 21 de junio de 1964, tres defensores de los derechos civiles, uno blanco y uno negro, desaparecieron de Mississippi mientras cruzaban el condado de Neshoba. Una investigación del FBI a gran escala llevó a la recuperación de los cuerpos de los hombres asesinados y la evidencia física fue recuperada y analizada. Los laboratorios del FBI confirmaron que todas excepto una de las balas usadas para asesinar a los hombres provenían de la misma arma. El FBI se ganó la confianza de un informante, cuya información condujo a la condena de siete miembros del Ku Klux Klan local.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Anchorage, Alaska, a young mother and her two daughters were sexually assaulted and brutally murdered. There was only one piece of forensic evidence: a washrag carrying pubic lice that the killer used to clean himself after the crime. Employing an unusual and original method, an FBI expert combed through all the hairs and fibers in the apartment. He was not only able to determine how long each hair had been there, but which hairs came from the killer and how the crime proceeded.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Two couples found themselves on the same deserted island paradise. But only one couple left alive. Buck Walker and Stephanie Stearns arrived in Hawaii on the Sea Wind, which belonged to the missing couple, Mac and Muff Graham. Buck and Stephanie were arrested and served time for boat theft. But years later, bones were discovered on the deserted island and identified as the remains of Muff Graham.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On June 21, 1964, three civil rights workers, two white and one black disappeared in Mississippi while passing through Neshoba County. A massive FBI investigation led to the recovery of the bodies of the slain men and physical evidence was recovered and analyzed. The FBI labs confirmed that all but one of the bullets used to kill the men came from the same gun. The FBI gained the trust of an informant, whose information led to the conviction of seven local Ku Klux Klan members.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: He wandered the streets of New York City wearing only pajamas and a bathrobe, but the FBI was convinced that Vince Gigante, the reputed boss of the Genovese crime family, was anything but crazy. The FBI used undercover surveillance, secret audio tapes, six mobsters turned government informants and the testimony of twelve FBI agents to help convict Gigante of murder and conspiracy-to-murder, including a plot to kill rival mob boss John Gotti.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: The rapes and murders of ten women near Tampa, Florida in 1984 had the authorities puzzled and the community scared. Since the beginning, the FBI had been analyzing the crime scene evidence and had found a common link: red trilobal carpet fibers. But there was no suspect, until one of the killer's potential victims survived. Through her interviews and the cooperation of local authorities and the FBI, 31-year-old Bobby Joe Long emerged as the prime suspect.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Claude Dallas lived the life of a cowboy. A loner and distrustful of authority, he lived off the land, poaching wildlife and selling the hides. But when two game wardens confronted Dallas about his deeds, they were shot and killed. After a massive manhunt, Dallas was captured and convicted, only to escape months later. Making the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, Dallas eluded the law for almost a year until the FBI tracked him down in a small town in California.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: He was a recluse who spread terror through the mail for 18 years. Two men died and more than a dozen were injured, but Ted Kaczynski wasn't known as the Unabomber until his brother tipped off the FBI. Kaczynski's “Unabomber Manifesto,” published in major newspapers, set off a flurry of activity for the FBI: writing analysis and comparisons, DNA gleaned from a single postage stamp and finally, Kaczynski's arrest at his tiny cabin.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared from a Christmas party in December 1989, the only probable suspect was 24-year-old Caleb Hughes. Hughes reportedly left the party around the time Melissa vanished, but no one saw him with the girl. Fifty blue acrylic fibers collected during a search of Hughes' car, however, became the major piece of evidence in the case. FBI fiber analysis determined that those fibers were identical to the ones that made up the sweater Melissa was wearing.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On February 26, 1993, an explosion rocked the World Trade Center parking garage. Six people died and more than a thousand were injured in the bomb blast that tore a 5-story crater in the building. During the investigation, the twisted fender of a rental van was extracted from the rubble. The FBI was able to determine from where the van was rented and by whom. Undercover agents then made their arrests within six days of the bombing.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: By December 1985, John Gotti had assumed his place as the new Don of the Gambino crime family in New York with the assassination of his boss, Paul Castellano. The Teflon Don felt secure in his position, always remaining one step ahead of the law. But he was also the ongoing obsession of Bruce Mouw, leader of an elite crew of FBI agents formed to bring down the Gambino family. With the help and genius of his Special Projects Squad, bugs were planted in Gotti's most private meeting places.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1984, south Miami became the home for a sadistic serial killer. Posing as a fashion photographer, Christopher Wilder lured young women from shopping malls with promises of fame and fortune. Most ended up dead. As the FBI closed in around him, Wilder took off on a cross-country murderous rampage. The FBI added Wilder to their Most Wanted Fugitives program. The chase was on, and Wilder ultimately lost.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Larry Horn nearly got away with the perfect crime: a multiple murder-for-hire plot that was meticulously planned and executed. Horn's former wife, their 8-year-old son, and a live-in nurse were all brutally murdered by an assassin. In the absence of any significant clues, police in Maryland contacted the FBI to assist in the investigation.

673500.title: Gidget Goes to Rome
673500.description: While on a trip to Rome, Gidget falls for a journalist, but romance turns complicated when she learns he is secretly watching over her.

673500.title: Scandal Sheet
673500.description: After accidentally killing his ex-wife, an editor of a tabloid newspaper discovers that his ace reporters are investigating the story.

673500.title: To Sir, With Love
673500.description: American Mark Thackeray (Sidney Poitier) recently received his degree in engineering, but cannot find work. To make ends meet, he takes a job as a teacher in a rough London East End school populated mostly with troublemakers who were rejected from other schools for their behavior. While the students at first see Thackeray as just another teacher open for ridicule and bullying, his calm demeanor and desire to see them succeed gradually earn him their respect.

673500.title: 5 Against the House
673500.description: At Harold's Club in Reno, what begins as a joke for four college friends ends as a reality, when a heist goes ahead with disastrous results.

673500.title: The Magic Carpet
673500.description: When his parents, the caliph and queen, are murdered by usurper Ali (Gregory Gaye), the newborn Ramoth is delivered to the safety of his uncle, Ahkmid (William Fawcett), via a magic carpet. The adult Ramoth (John Agar) becomes masked hero the Scarlet Falcon. After tricking the reigning caliph into appointing him the royal physician, Ramoth learns of his noble birth and, with the help of faithful Razi (George Tobias) and beautiful Lida (Patricia Medina), he fights Ali and his wrathful minions.

673500.title: The Game That Kills
673500.description: A man infiltrates a hockey team to investigate the death of his brother, the team's star left wing.

673500.title: The Big Heat
673500.description: A police officer seems to have committed suicide, but Detective Dave Bannion (Glenn Ford) thinks there's more to the story. After talking to the man's mob-connected mistress, Bannion discovers far-reaching corruption that leads all the way from the police station to kingpin Mike Lagana (Alexander Scourby). But when the policeman's lover is killed, it becomes clear that crossing Lagana is a dangerous thing to do. Soon Bannion finds himself marked for death and his family in mortal danger.

673500.title: The Caine Mutiny
673500.description: During World War II, a dilapidated vessel, the Caine, gets a new ensign, Willis Keith (Robert Francis), and a new captain, Commander Queeg (Humphrey Bogart). The crew sees Queeg's unconventional behavior as irrational, and communications officer Thomas Keefer (Fred MacMurray) spreads suspicion about his suitability as captain. When a dire situation during a storm forces the executive officer (Van Johnson) to relieve Queeg of his duties, he and Ensign Keith are tried for mutiny.

673498.description: Old West outlaw Bill Doolin (Randolph Scott) marries a deacon's wife, but his gang will not leave him alone.

673498.description: An Army lieutenant (George Montgomery) is ordered to go after Florida Indians in Texas.

673498.title: One Man Law
673498.description: Settlers and a sheriff catch on to a Chicago swindler's land scam.

673498.title: Riders of Black River
673498.description: A former Texas Ranger's plans to marry are complicated by his future brother-in-law's involvement with cattle rustlers.

673498.title: Battle of Rogue River
673498.description: A cavalry major (George Montgomery) makes peace with Indians despite an agitator (Richard Denning) working for carpetbaggers.

673498.title: Santa Fe
673498.description: Three brothers become outlaws after the Civil War, while a fourth sibling goes to work for the railroad.

673498.title: The Wild Westerners
673498.description: A U.S. marshal (James Philbrook) and his wife (Nancy Kovack) bring Union gold east through outlaws and Indians.

673498.title: Gunman's Walk
673498.description: Rancher Lee Hackett (Van Heflin) spends so much time trying to keep the violent streak of his son Ed (Tab Hunter) in check, he neglects the needs of his other son Davy (James Darren). When Ed's temper results in the death of an innocent Native American, Lee tries his best to cover his son's tracks by making a deal with unscrupulous horse trader Jensen (Ray Teal), who falsely testifies on Ed's behalf. But it becomes clear that Ed can't change, and a shootout between father and son ensues.

673498.title: Indian Uprising
673498.description: Gold thieves and the government rile Geronimo, despite a cavalry captain's (George Montgomery) efforts at peace.

673498.title: Return to Warbow
673498.description: Three escaped convicts return to collect the money that the brother of one of them has already spent.

673498.title: Jubal
673498.description: Searching for work, cowboy Jubal Troop (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small town, where he badly injures his hand. Fortunately, a local rancher, Shep Horgan (Ernest Borgnine), is willing to employ Troop despite the injury. Horgan and Troop work together amicably, but Horgan's two-timing wife (Valerie French) threatens to create discord when she becomes interested in Troop, although he really loves another woman. A jealous cowhand (Rod Steiger) complicates matters by spreading lies.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: For a guy who started life as a free spirited outlaw-biker Dog has certainly turned into a family man. His children touch everything he does today, from searching for the perfect gift for his daughter Cecily's birthday to hunting a fugitive.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Only in Dog's world would a bantam fighting cock, a pregnant daughter, and a jungle safe house go together. And don't forget the mopeds as well a group of hostile squatters on government land! They're all part of the hunt for an elusive criminal.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: What's a father to do? When the cops ask Dog for help tracking down a renegade teen with a history of running hard, Baby Lyssa, eight months pregnant and counting, insists on joins the hunt.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: For Dog and Beth it's not only another day in paradise, it's their anniversary. Beth is hoping for a romantic dinner with her man, but she knows only too well that for Dog work always comes first.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Today Dog finds himself looking for more than one fugitive. He starts the day looking for a woman who has skipped out on her court date.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: A big heart can be a problem for a bail bondsman and today's hunt is a case in point. Dog gave a break to a young man with a drug problem who promised to enter drug rehab.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog's latest fugitive, doesn't think small when it comes to illegal drugs: he was carrying almost a pound of methamphetamine when he was arrested. Now he's on the run with his pregnant girlfriend on the high plains of Colorado.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog is back in Hawaii and tracking a dangerous fugitive through the jungles of the Big Island. Their prey is being protected by a ring of family and friends that Dog must forcefully confront to bring in his man.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: When Dog decides to spend the day caring for his newest granddaughter, Beth enlists the girls to hunt down a female fugitive. Heading into a dangerous part of town the ladies will use their feminine wiles to track this mother gone wrong.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Fugitive beware: Dog's rolling with extra power today. His old friends Tim Chapman and Sonny Westbrook are riding with the team, so their target, a thief with violent tendencies, is out of luck.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog doesn't have the whole team today and he's got to catch a fugitive with a record of criminal assault. But when Dog finds the fugitive's former girlfriend, she thinks he isn't dangerous at all.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog's latest quarry is running from abuse and assault charges. As Dog investigates, he discovers that this fugitive has gamed the system by jumping from one bond, and one bondsman, to another.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

724210.description: Len Richards and his brother, Ab, confront a Lucas McCain look-alike, Earl Bantry and his sidekick K.C. Peters, for slaughtering one of Richards' steers.

724210.description: Lucas and Mark stop on the way to the county fair to deliver a message to Micah, who is escorting a prisoner to be hanged. Mark and Lucas recognize the prisoner.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark and Milly are shocked when Lucas begins gambling. They don't know that Lucas is "undercover" trying to catch a man cheating.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark befriends singer-banjoist Lafayette Bly, a blind man with an acute sense of hearing and a very strong grip.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A retired lawman's irrational jealousy threatens not only to destroy his marriage but also to make him an easy target for someone who wants him dead.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: No one is more surprised than Micah when newcomer Leota Carraway claims he's her long-lost husband and the father of her child.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas is torn by conflicting emotions when he meets the town's new preacher, a former outlaw whom the Rifleman vowed to kill.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The town of North Fork becomes a haven for outlaws when suave Ben Judson smooth-talks his way into the marshal's job.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A handsome gambler moves into town and begins wooing Milly Scott, claiming to have known her deceased brother.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas develops temporary amnesia from a head injury while visiting a strange town and mistakenly assumes the identity of a wanted criminal.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A former neighbor of the McCains' is released from jail after serving his sentence for robbery. Lucas lets the man work for him but the new hand holds a secret.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When Lucas, Mark, and Micah get lost in Old Mexico, they are held hostage by a group of bandits who intend to kill the men and take Mark as a slave.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: While trapped in the ghost town saloon, Lucas tries to come up with a plan to escape with his son and Micah after Mark refuses to leave without him.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lou Mallory arrives in North Fork and starts buying up land and businesses. Lou and Lucas start disliking each other after she reveals plans to build a railroad on "worthless" land.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When a woman arrives in North Fork with symptoms of smallpox, Lucas, Lou Mallory, Doctor Burrage and hotel occupants are quarantined in the hotel with an outlaw.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Gunslinger Johnny Drako rides into town and tells the bartender that he is looking for Lucas McCain. After Johnny leaves the saloon, Sweeney hurries to tell Lucas.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A man arrives in North Fork, intending to marry Lou Mallory. The hotel owner looks for a way out from marrying the man to whom her dying father promised her.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: An assassination plot unfolds as four gunmen disguised as cavalrymen enter North Fork. Their target: Sen. Jim Borden. Their weapon: a Gatling gun.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Sharpshooter Marty Blair tries to persuade Lucas to buy Mark a rifle. After Lucas shoots a man during a robbery at the hotel, Mark and Lucas disagree his character.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Fast-draw artist Wade Randall is in town, bragging of his gun battles with notorious bad men, until one of them shows up to challenge his story.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When Lucas refuses to sell his land, Mr. Prescott will stop at nothing to to change his mind. He hires men to try to persuade Lucas, but he refuses.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark's careless actions cause the death of a friend. Unable to accept the truth, he blames the rifle and runs away from home. Soon, he is faced with a tough decision.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Nils Swenson takes the marshal's place for a few days while Micah is away. To maintain peace, Nils insists that anyone coming into town must turn in their weapons.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas's self-confidence begins to slip away when he misses an easy shot that could have cost Mark his life.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A murder occurs at a railroad camp and a young Indian friend of Lucas' is accused of the killing. When Lucas tries to help the boy, he finds himself on trial.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark come upon Winslow Quince, a peddler whose wagon has broken down. They help him bring his wagon to North Fork for repair.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Gridley Mau, the son of a man Lucas killed during an attempted robbery, comes to North Fork looking for revenge.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The first railroad train is coming to the new North Fork station. On board is a Japanese nobleman and his servant, visiting the West to learn about the United States.

400000059.title: Doctor Who: The Aztecs

400000059.description: (1/6) The crew onboard a spaceship have been trapped in a state of permanent paralysis.

400000059.description: (2/6) Communicating through Susan using telepathic powers, the Sensorites contact the Doctor.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who
400000059.description: (3/6) The Doctor and his companions uncover a shattering truth on the Sense-Sphere.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who
400000059.description: (4/6) Convinced that Ian has actually been poisoned, the Doctor decides to investigate.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who
400000059.description: (5/6) Carol puts herself in danger when she attempts to find the Doctor at the aqueduct.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who
400000059.description: (6/6) The Doctor and Ian discover the identity of the strange creatures that poisoned the water.

400000059.title: Doctor Who: Planet of Giants
400000059.description: The crew arrive in a place where everything is on a giant scale.

400000059.title: Doctor Who: Planet of Giants
400000059.description: The Doctor realizes that the government scientist, Farrow, has been murdered.

400000059.title: Doctor Who: Planet of Giants
400000059.description: The Doctor and Susan are reunited with Ian and Barbara.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who: The Dalek Invasion of Earth
400000059.description: (1/6) The Doctor and his companions arrive in a London very different from what they remember.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who: The Dalek Invasion of Earth
400000059.description: (2/6) The Doctor and Ian are captured and taken to the Dalek ship.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who: The Dalek Invasion of Earth
400000059.description: (3/6) Hiding on board the Dalek spaceship, Ian is taken to the mines of Bedfordshire.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who: The Dalek Invasion of Earth
400000059.description: (4/6) The Doctor, Susan and David discover a nearby firebomb, left by Robomen to destroy London.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who: The Dalek Invasion of Earth
400000059.description: (5/6) Ian and his friend Larry are chased by the Slyther, protecting the Bedfordshire mines.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who: The Dalek Invasion of Earth
400000059.description: (6/6) Barbara realises how to control the Robomen and orders an attack on the Daleks.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who
400000059.description: (1/2) The Doctor and his companions meet a lonely orphan and a paralyzed man.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who
400000059.description: (2/2) The Doctor realizes that Bennett has not been honest with him or with Vicki.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who: The Romans
400000059.description: (1/4) The Doctor is mistaken for a murdered lyre player and targeted by an assassin.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who: The Romans
400000059.description: (2/4) Barbara is sold as a slave and Ian is to be trained as a gladiator.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who: The Romans
400000059.description: (3/4) Poppaea plans to poison Barbara who has become the object of Neros affections.

400000059.title: Classic Doctor Who: The Romans
400000059.description: (4/4) Inspired by the Doctor, Nero sets Rome ablaze.

400000059.title: Doctor Who: The Web Planet
400000059.description: The TARDIS lands on a planet that affects its systems. The Doctor and his companions must save the ship.

400000059.description: The Doctor, Ian and Vicki have been captured by the Zarbi and taken into a control center.

400000059.title: Doctor Who: The Web Planet
400000059.description: Ian and the Menoptra Vrestin try to escape the pursuing Zarbi but the ground gives way beneath them.

400000059.title: Doctor Who: The Web Planet
400000059.description: Barbara and Prapillus are caught in the middle of fighting between the menoptra and the Zarbi.

400000059.title: Doctor Who: The Web Planet
400000059.description: The Doctor and Vicki are herded into a chamber where they are enveloped in a web-like substance.

400000059.title: Doctor Who: The Web Planet
